text.body: <1> śrīmadhusūdanasarasvatīpraṇītaṃ śrībhagavadbhaktirasāyanam tadviracitā prathamollāsasya ṭīkāmatallikā ca | prathamaḥullāsaḥ navarasamilitaṃ vā kevalaṃ vā pumarthaṃ paramamiha mukunde bhaktiyogaṃ vadanti | nirupamasukhasaṃvidrūpamaspṛṣṭadumkhaṃ tamahamakhilatuṣṭyai śāstradṛṣṭyā vyanajmi ||1|| ṭīkāḥ padanakhaniviṣṭamūrtibhirekādaśatāmivāvahanniṣṭām | yaṃ samupāste giriśastaṃ vande nandamandire kaṃcita|| granthārambhe sambhāvitavighnanivāraṇabuddhyā bhagavadanudhyānarūpamaṅgalmaṅgīkurvannādau prekṣāpūrvakāripravṛttyaṅgatayābhidheyaprayojanasambandhānācaṣṭe śiṣṭāgraṇīgranthakāro navaraseti | karmayogo'ṣṭāṅgayogo jñānayogo bhaktiyoga iti catvāraṃ pumarthatvena prasiddhā yogām -- yogāstrayo mayā proktā nèṇāṃ śreyovidhitsayā | jñānaṃ karma ca bhaktiśca nopāyo'nyo'sti kutracita|| iti bhagavadvacanenāṣṭāṅgayogo'pi jñānayogāntargato draṣṭavyam | mana ekatra saṃyuñjyājjitaśvāso jitāsanam | vairāgyābhyāsayogena dhriyamāṇamatandritam || ityapi tasyāpi vyutpādanāta| tatra -- garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīmantonnayanajātakarmanāmakaraṇānnaprāśanacaulopanayanāni, catvāri vedavratāni, snānaṃ sahadharmacāriṇīsaṃyogam, pañcamahāyajñānāmanuṣṭhānamaṣṭakāpārvaṇaśrāddhaśrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇī caitryāśvayujī ceti saptapākayajñasaṃsthā, agnyādheyamagnihotradarśapaurṇamāsāvāgrayaṇaṃ cāturmāsyāni nirūḍhapaśubandhaṃ sautrāmaṇī ceti sapta haviryajñasthām, agniṣṭomo'tyagniṣṭome ukthyaṃ ṣoḍaśī vājapeyo'tirātrāptoryāma iti sapta somayajñasaṃsthāśca ityādiśāstravihito varṇāśramadharmarūpaṃ karmayogo'ntamkaraṇaśuddhisādhanatvena tāvatparyantamanuṣṭheyam -- tāvatkarmāṇi kurvīta na nirvidyeta yāvatā | matkathāśravaṇādau vā śraddhā yāvanna jāyate || iti bhagavadvacanāta| antamkaraṇaśuddhisādhanatvaṃ ca -- tasya dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati tasmāddharmaṃ paramaṃ vadanti, yena kena yajñenāpi vā darvihomenānupahatamanā eva bhavati ityādi śrutisiddham | tataścādrutacittasyanirvedapūrvakaṃ tattvajñānam | drutacittasya tu bhagavatkathāśravaṇādibhāgavatadharmaśraddhāpūrvikā bhaktirityavadhitvena dvayamapyupāttam | tato'ntamkaraṇaśuddhyāṣṭāṅgayogamanuṣṭhāya tailadhārāvadavicchinnabhagavadekākārapratyayaparamparātmakaikāgratāyogyaṃ manaṃ sampādayeta| yadārambheṣu nirviṇṇo viraktaṃ saṃyatendriyam | abhyāsenātmanā yogī dhārayedacalaṃ manam || dhāryamāṇaṃ mano yarhi bhrāmyadāśvanavasthitam | atandrito'nurodhena mārgeṇātmavaśaṃ nayeta|| ityādibhagavadvacanāta| tasmiṃśca sati amānitvamadambhitvamityārabhya etajjñānamiti proktaṃ ityantena granthena śrīmadbhagavadgītopaniṣadupadiṣṭo jñānayogaṃ pratiṣṭhito bhavati dehendriyādyanāsaṅgātmakam | asya ca jñānayogasya bhaktiyogo'vadhim | sāṅkhyena sarvabhāvānāṃ pratilomānulomatam | bhavāpyayāvanudhyāyenmano yāvatprasīdati || nirviṇṇasya viraktasya puruṣasyoktavedinam | manastyajati daurātmyaṃ cintitasyānucintayā || yamādibhiryogapathairānvīkṣikyā ca vidyayā | mamārcopāsanābhirvā nānyairyogyaṃ smarenmanam || ityādibhagavadvacanāta| proktena bhaktiyogena bhajato māsakṛnmunem | kāmā hṛdayyā naśyanti sarve mayi hṛdi sthite || ityādibhagavadvacanānusāriṇyā sādhanabhaktiniṣṭhayā nikhilamapi viṣayaniṣṭhapremāṇaṃ bhagavatyeva pratiṣṭhāpayataṃ sakalaviṣayavimukhamanaso mahābhāgasya kasyacidbhagavadguṇagarimagranthanarūpagranthaśravaṇajanitadrutirūpāyāṃ manovṛttau sarvasādhanaphalabhūtāyāṃ gṛhītabhagavadākārāyāṃ vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogena rasarūpatayābhivyakto bhagavadākāratārūpo ratyākhyasthāyibhāvaṃ paramānandasākṣātkārātmakaṃ prādurbhavati | sa eva bhaktiyoga iti taṃ paramaṃ niratiśayaṃ puruṣārthaṃ vadanti rasajñām | tasmānmadbhaktiyuktasya yogino vai madātmanam | na jñānaṃ na ca vairāgyaṃ prāyaṃ śreyo bhavediha || yatkarmabhiryattapasā jñānavairāgyataśca yata| yogena dāmadharmeṇa śreyobhiritarairapi || sarvaṃ madbhaktiyogena madbhakto labhate'ñjasā | svargāpavargaṃ maddhāma kathañcidyadi vāñchati || na kiñcitsādhavo dhīrā bhaktā hyekāntino mama | vāñchantyapi mayā dattaṃ kaivalyamapunarbhavam || nairapekṣyaṃ paraṃ prāhurnimśreyasamanalpakam | tasmānnirāśiṣo bhaktirnirapekṣasya me bhaveta|| na mayyekāntabhaktānāṃ guṇadoṣodbhavā guṇām | sādhūnāṃ samacittānāṃ buddheṃ paramupeyuṣām || ityādivacanāni, tadanubhavitāraśca | dumkhāsambhinnasukhaṃ hi paramaṃ puruṣārtha iti sarvatantrasiddhāntaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣāścatvāraṃ puruṣārthā iti prasiddhistu lāṅgalaṃ mama jīvanamitivatsādhane phalatvavacanādaupacārikī | ato na sukhameva puruṣārtha iti pakṣahānim | sukhaṃ dumkhābhāvaśca dvau puruṣārthāviti tārkikām | tanna, lāghavena sukhamātrasyaiva puruṣārthatvakalpanāta| icchājanakatve hi jñānasya sukhaviṣayakatvamevāvacchedakam | na tu sukhadumkhābhāvānyataraviṣayakatvaṃ gauravāta| dumkhābhāvasya tu sukhaparicāyakatvenaivopayogam | yattu nyāyanibandhanakāraiṃ śaṅkitam -- dumkhābhāvasya sukhārthatvenaivopayoge'bhihite sukhasyāpi dumkhābhāvārthatvenopayogo vaktuṃ śakyate, vyāpyavyāpakabhāvasyaiva vinigamakatvāta| yadā sukhaṃ tadā dumkhābhāva iti hi vyāptiṃ sarvasammatā, nirupādhisahacāradarśanāta| ato dumkhābhāvasya sukhakāle'vaśyambhāvitvāt, sukhaparicāyakatvamupapadyate, tadvyāpakatvāttasya | yadā dumkhābhāvastadā sukhamiti na tadvyāptim | suṣuptipralayādau vyabhicārāta| ato dumkhābhāvasya sukhāvyāpyatvānna tatparicāyakatvaṃ sukhasya | vyāpakaṃ hi vyāpyasthitihetutvenānyathāsiddham | sukhaṃ ca na dumkhābhāvavyāpakamatastadeva svatantraṃ puruṣārtham | dumkhābhāvasya sukhārthatvenopayoge sarvasukhaśūnyasya dumkhābhāvasya mokṣasya puruṣārthatvaṃ na syāditi cet, dīyatāṃ jalāñjalistasmai | paramānandarūpatvena tu tasya puruṣārthatvaṃ vedāntavido vadanti | ato bhagavadbhaktiyogasyāpi dumkhāsambhinnasukhatvenaiva paramapuruṣārthatvamityāha -- nirupamasukhasaṃvidrūpamaspṛṣṭadumkhamiti | etena bhaktirna puruṣārtho dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣvanantarbhāvādityādikaṃ sarvamapāstam | dharmārthakāmānāṃ svataṃ puruṣārthatvābhāvāttajjanyasukhasyaiva puruṣārthatve gauravādananugamācca dharmajanyatvādiviśeṣaṇaṃ parityajya sukhamātraṃ puruṣārtha iti sthite samādhisukhasyeva bhaktisukhasyāpi svatantrapuruṣārthatvāta| tasya mokṣasamīpavartitayā mokṣāntarbhūtatve yogajadharmajanyā dharmāntarbhūtatve vā bhaktisukhasyāpi bhāgavatadharmajanyatayā dharmātarbhāvasya śraddhājaḍānprati vaktuṃ śakyatvāta| bhaktasya saṃsāramokṣasyāvaśyakatvānmokṣāntargato vā bhaktiyogam | tasmātpuruṣārthacatuṣṭaya'ntargatatvena vā svātantryeṇa vā bhaktiyogaṃ puruṣārthaṃ paramānandarūpatvāditi nirvivādam | tasya paramānandarūpatāmupapādayannavāntaravibhāgamāha -- navarasamilitaṃ vā kevalaṃ veti | spaṣṭametadupariṣṭātkariṣyate | mukunda iti bhaktiyogasya viṣayanirdeśam | sarvāntaryāmī sarveśvara eva bhaktirasālambanavibhāva iti vakṣyate | granthādau cedaṃ maṅgalamācaritam | sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu nāsti teṣāmamaṅgalam | yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavānmaṅgalāyatanaṃ harim || iti smṛtem | tamahaṃ vyanjmi ityabhidheyasambandhanirdeśaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyetyamūlatvanivāraṇam | akhilatuṣṭyai iti prayojananirdeśam | sādhūnāṃ hi tuṣṭiṃ svābhāvikī | anyeṣāmapyetadgranthoktayuktibhirasambhāvanāviparītabhāvanādinivṛttyāntamkaraṇaśuddherhetorityabhiprāyam | ke punarbhaktiyogasya pumarthatvavādāṃ ? śṛṇu tān -- na hyato'nyaṃ śivaṃ panthā viśataṃ saṃsṛtāviha | vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktiyogo yato bhaveta|| dharmaṃ svanuṣṭhitaṃ puṃsāṃ viṣvaksenakathāsu yam | notpādayedyadi ratiṃ śrama eva hi kevalam || dānavrātatapohoma japasvādhyāyasaṃyamaim | śreyobhirvividhaiścānyaiṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktirhi sādhyate || bhagavānbrahma kārtsnyena triranvīkṣya manīṣayā | tadadhyavasyatkūṭastho ratirātmanyato bhaveta|| etāvāneva loke'sminpuṃsāṃ nimśreyasodayam | tīvreṇa bhaktiyogena mano mayyarpitaṃ sthiram || yā nirvṛtistanubhṛtāṃ tava pādapadma dhyānādbhavajjanakathāśravaṇena vā syāta| sā brahmaṇi svamahimanyapi nātha mā bhūt kiṃ tvantakāsilulitātpatatāṃ vimānāta|| ityādayam | atra hi sarvasukṛtasādhyatvena tātparyaviṣayatvena cārthānnimśreyasanirvṛtiśabdābhyāṃ ca sākṣādeva puruṣārthatvaṃ darśitam | śrīmadbhagavadgītāsu ca -- yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā | śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo matam || ityādinā | nanu bhaktiyogasya sādhanatvamapi bodhayantyanye vādām -- vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktiyogaṃ prayojitam | janayatyāśu vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ ca yadahaitukam || akāmaṃ sarvakāmo vā mokṣakāma udāradhīm | tīvreṇa bhaktiyogena yajeta puruṣaṃ param || kecitkevalayā bhaktyā vāsudevaparāyaṇām | aghaṃ dhunvanti kārtsnyena nīhāramiva bhāskaram || śrīmadbhagavadgītāsu ca -- bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvatam | tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram || ityādayam | atrānyasādhanatvena sākṣādapuruṣārthatvaṃ spaṣṭamevoktam | atrocyate -- phalasādhanabhedena bhaktidvaividhyopapatteradoṣam | tathā hi -- bhajanamantamkaraṇasya bhagavadākāratārūpaṃ bhaktiriti bhāvavyutpattyā bhaktiśabdena phalamabhidhīyate | tasya ca niratiśayapumarthatvātpūrvoktavādānāṃ prāmāṇyamavyāhatam | tathā -- bhajyate sevyate bhagavadākāramantamkaraṇaṃ kriyate'nayeti karaṇavyutpattyā bhaktiśabdena śravaṇakīrtanādisādhanamabhidhīyate, tasya puruṣārthatvābhāvātsādhanatvavādānāmapi prāmāṇyamaviruddham | yathā -- vijñaptirvijñānamiti bhāvavyutpattyā vijñānamānandaṃ brahma ityatra vijñānaśabdo brahmaṇi vartate | vijñāyate'neneti karaṇavyutpattyā vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute ityādāvantamkaraṇe vartate tadvata| etacca spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ prabuddhena -- smarantaṃ smārayantaśca mitho'ghaughaharaṃ harim | bhaktyā sañjātayā bhaktyā bibhratyutpulakāṃ tanum || iti | atra karaṇavyutpattyā prathamabhaktiśabdo bhāgavatadharmeṣu prayuktam, dvitīyastu bhāvavyutpattyā phale | iti bhāgavatāndharmānśikṣanbhaktyā tadutthayā | nārāyaṇaparo māyāmañjastarati dustarām || ityupasaṃhāre prathamabhaktipadasthāne bhāgavatadharmaśabdaprayogāta| na cayathādhyayanasyākṣaregrahaṇātmakasyāpyakṣaragrahaṇameva phalam | gurvadhīnatvatadanadhīnatvābhyāṃ viśeṣāta| evamatrāpi bhāgavatadharmarūpā bhaktireva gurvadhīnatvena sādhanam | tadanadhīnatvena ca niṣṭhāṃ prāptā satī saiva phalamiti na sādhanaphalabhedena bhaktidvaividhyopapattiriti vācyam | kvacidrudantyacyutacintayā kvacid dhasanti nandanti vadantyalaukikām | nṛtyanti gāyantyanuśīlayantyajaṃ bhavanti tūṣṇīṃ parametya nirvṛtām || iti madhye kṛtakṛtyatvaparāmarśāta| yadā hyadhyayanaphalasyākṣaragrahaṇasyārthajñānānuṣṭhānādivadbhāgavatadharmajanitāyā bhakterapi phalāntare sādhanatvamabhaviṣyat, tadā paraṃ puruṣārthaṃ prāpya nirvṛtāstūṣṇīṃ bhavantīti kṛtārthatāṃ nāvakṣyata| api tu, tadanantaramanuṣṭheyānantaraṃ niradekṣyat, na ca niridśati | tasmātsādhanaphalabhedena bhaktidvaividhyopapatteṃ sādhanatvavacanānāṃ phalatvavacanānāṃ ca viṣayavibhāgena sarvatrāvirodhaṃ siddham | aghaṃ dhunvanti kārtsnyena ityādi tu phalasādhanayoṃ samānam | phalarūpāyā api bhakterdṛṣṭaphalakatāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāta| evaṃ ca -- idaṃ hi puṃsastapasaṃ śrutasya vā sviṣṭasya sūktasya ca buddhidattayom | avicyuto'rthaṃ kavibhirnirūpito yaduttamaślokaguṇānuvarṇanam || nivṛttatarṣairupagīyamānād bhavauṣadhācchrotramano'bhirāmāta| ka uttamaślokaguṇānuvādāt pumānvirajyeta vinā paśughnāta|| ityādau sādhanavacanaṃ phalaparatayā yojanīyam | gobhiṃ śrīṇīta matsaramitivata| tatra hi goprabhavaiṃ kṣīrairmatsaraṃ somarasaṃ miśrayedityarthaṃ sthitaṃ pūrvatantre | uttaratantre ca mahataṃ paramavyaktamityatrāvyaktaśabdastatprabhavaśarīramācaṣṭa iti sthitamānuṣamānikādhikaraṇe sūkṣmaṃ tu tadarthatvātityatra | evamatrāpi guṇānuvarṇanaguṇānuvādaśabdau ca tajjanyaprītiparatayā yojyau | anyathā parapuruṣārthatvāyogāta| nanu tarhi nānāntareṇa brahmavidyaiva bhagavadbhaktirityuktam | tathā hi -- tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakena ityādi śrutyā sarvasukṛtasādhyatvena brahmavidyā pratipāditā | sarvāpekṣādhikaraṇe ca tathaiva nirṇītā | ihāpi pūrvodāhṛtavacanaiṃ sarvasukṛtasādhyatvena lakṣaṇena bhagavadbhakterbrahmavidyārūpatāyāṃ pratipādanāttasyāśca niratiśayapumarthatvasya caturlakṣaṇamīmāṃsayāpratipattivipratipattinivāraṇena vyavasthāpitatvādvyartho'yaṃ vicārārambha iti cet? na, svarūpasādhanaphalādhikārivailakṣaṇyādbhaktibrahmavidyayom | dravībhāvapūrvikā hi manaso bhagavadākāratā savikalpakavṛttirūpā bhaktim | dravībhāvānupetādvitīyātmamātragocarā nirvikalpakamanovṛttirbrahmavidyā | bhagavadguṇagarimagranthanarūpagranthaśravaṇaṃ bhaktisādhanam | tattvamasyādi vedāntamahāvākyaṃ brahmavidyāsādhanam | bhagavadviṣayakapremaprakarṣo bhaktiphalam | sarvānarthamūlājñānanivṛttirbrahmavidyāphalam | prāṇimātrasya bhaktāvadhikāram | brahmavidyāyāṃ tu sādhanacatuṣṭaya sampannasya paramahaṃsaparivrājakasya | yajñadānādisarvasukṛtasādhyatvaṃ tu samānaṃ bhaktibrahmavidyayoṃ svargavividiṣayoriva | yathā, svargakāmo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta iti sthita eva svargasādhanatve svargebhyaṃ kāmebhyo darśapaurṇamāsau iti vākyena phalāntaratvamapi bodhyate | tathā, tametaṃ vedānuvacanena ityādinā vividiṣāsādhanatvamapi saṃyogapṛthaktvanyāyena bodhyate, tathā bhaktibrahmavidyayorapi bhaviṣyati | sāmagryaikyaṃ hi kāryaikye na tu kāraṇamātraikye, atiprasaṅgāta| evaṃ bhaktibrahmavidyayorapi svargavividiṣayoriva phalasādhanabhāvābhāvaśca tulyasādhanasādhyatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | nanu, brahmavidyātiriktatve bhakteṃ svargādivanniratiśayapuruṣārthatvaṃ na syāditi cenna, svargāderniyatadeśakālaśarīrendriyādibhogyatvena sarvatropabhoktumaśakyatvātkṣayitvapāratantryalakṣaṇadumkhadvayānubiddhatvena niratiśayatvābhāve'pi bhaktisukhadhārāyāṃ sarvadeśakālaśarīrendriyādisādhāraṇyena brahmavidyāphalavadupabhoktuṃ śakyatvātkṣayitvapāratantryalakṣaṇadumkhadvayānuvedhābhāvena niratiśayatvopapattem | taduktam -- tyaktvā svadharmaṃ caraṇāmbujaṃ harer bhajannapakvo'tha patettato yadi | yatra kva vābhadramabhūdamuṣya kiṃ ko vārtha āpto'bhajatāṃ svadharmatam || tasyaiva hetoṃ prayateta kovido na labhyate yadbhramatāmuparyadham | tallabhyate dumkhavadanyataṃ sukhaṃ kālena sarvatra gabhīraraṃhasā || na vai jano jātu kathañcanāvrajen mukundasevyanyavadaṅga saṃsṛtim | smaranmukundāṅghryupagūhanaṃ punar vihātumicchenna rasagraho janam || sakṛnmanaṃ kṛṣṇapadāravindayor niveśitaṃ tadguṇarāgi yairiha | na te yamaṃ pāśabhṛtaśca tadbhaṭān svapne'pi paśyanti hi cīrṇaniṣkṛtām || ityādi | ata evāpattāvapi dumkhāsaṃsparśitvapratipādanāyāspṛṣṭadumkhamiti viśeṣaṇamupāttam | ata eva ca na pariṇativirasena svargādinā sāmyam | etena laukikarasavailakṣaṇyamapi vyākhyātam | tasyāpi śāstrāvihitatvena pāpakṣayāhetutvenāpattau dumkhasaṃsparśitatvāta| bhaktestu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalatayā mahānviśeṣo vakṣyate | nanvevaṃ sati bhaktisukhādvairāgyāsambhavena mumukṣutvāsambhavāttadadhikārikacaturlakṣaṇamīmāṃsārambho na syāditi cet, satyam | bhaktisukhāsaktānprati tasyā anārambhāta| bhajanīyasvarūpanirṇayārthaṃ bhaktānāmapi tadvicārasyāvaśyakatvācca | bhaktisukhādvairāgyaṃ na syāditi tviṣṭameva nāpāditam | ātmārāmāśca munayo nirgranthā apyurukrame | kurvantyahaitukīṃ bhaktimitthambhūtaguṇo harim || ityādinā jīvanmuktānāmapi bhagavadbhaktipratipādanāta||1|| [iti vakṣyamāṇasarvārthasaṅgraharūpaprathamakārikāvivaraṇam |] saṃsārarogeṇa balīyasā ciraṃ nipīḍitaistatpraśame'tiśikṣitam | idaṃ bhavadbhirbahudhā vyayātigaṃ nipīyatāṃ bhaktirasāyanaṃ budhām ||2|| tasmādasya granthasya nāmakanathadvārā prayojanamupadiśati -- saṃsāreti | spaṣṭam ||2|| drutasya bhagavaddharmāddhārāvāhikatāṃ gatā | sarveśe manaso vṛttirbhaktirityabhidhīyate ||3|| bhagavadbhakte rasarūpatayā pumarthatāṃ vaktuṃ prathamaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamācaṣṭad -- drutasyeti | bhagavaddharmo'tra bhagavadguṇaśravaṇam | na tu dharambuddhyā tadanuṣṭhānaparyantaṃ vivakṣitam | tasmātkenāpyupāyena manaṃ kṛṣṇe niveśayetityatrāpi kenāpyupāyeneti dharmabuddhyā'nuṣṭhitenāyatnasiddhena vā bhagavadguṇaśravaṇenetyartham | tena śiśupālādau nāvyāptiṃ bhagavadguṇaśravaṇena vakṣyamāṇakāmakrodhādyuddīpanadvārā dravāvasthāṃ prāptasya cittasya dhārāvāhikī yā sarveśaviṣayā vṛttim | bhagavadākāratetyartham | tadākārataiva hi sarvatra vṛttiśabdārtho'smākaṃ darśane | sā bhaktirityabhidhīyate śāstravidbhim | tathā ca śāstram -- madguṇaśrutimātreṇa mayi sarvaguhāśaye | manogatiravicchinnā yathā gaṅgāmbhaso'mbudhau || lakṣaṇaṃ bhaktiyogasya nirguṇasya hyudāhṛtam | ahaitukyavyavahitā yā bhaktiṃ puruṣottame || atrāvicchinneti dhārāvāhikatā darśitā | yathā gaṅgāmbhasa iti dṛṣṭāntena dārṣṭāntike'pi manasi dravāvasthā | mayi sarvaguhāśaye manovṛttiriti sarveśākāratā | tenādravāvasthāyāṃ dhārāvāhikyapi vṛttidravāvasthāyāmapyāśu vināśinī sā | dravatvadhārāvāhikatvayuktāpyasarveśaviṣayā na bhaktirityuktam ||3|| cittadravyaṃ hi jatuvatsvabhāvātkaṭhinātmakam | tāpakairviṣayairyoge dravatvaṃ pratipadyate ||4|| tadeva spaṣṭayituṃ cittaceṣṭitamācaṣṭe -- citteti | jatuno hi dahanātmakatāpakayogamantareṇa kāṭhinyaśāntirna bhavati | saurālokādiyoge tu śithilībhāvamātraṃ na drutiriti sarvasiddham | evaṃ cittasyāpi vakṣyamāṇakāmādiviṣayātmakatāpakasaṃyoge vinā na dravībhāvo, viṣayamātrasañoge tu śithilībhāvamātramiti tāpakapadopādānena sūcitam ||4|| kāmakrodhabhayasnehaharṣaśokadayādayam | tāpakāścittajatunastacchāntau kaṭhinaṃ tu tata||5|| tāneva tāpakānāha -- kāmeti | eṣāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇabhedāṃśca vakṣyati | yadviṣaye kāmādīnāmudrekastadviṣaye cittasya dravībhāvam | punarviṣayāntarasañcārādinā kāmāditirobhāve kāṭhinyamevetyartham ||5|| drute citte vinikṣiptasvākāro yastu vastunā | saṃskāravāsanābhāvabhāvanāśabdabhāgasau ||6|| dravībhāvaprayojanamāha -- druta iti | na tu vinaśyatā jñānena janitastārikādiparikalpita ātmaguṇa ityartham ||6|| śithilībhāvamātraṃ tu mano gacchatyatāpakaim | na tatra vastu viśati vāsanātvena kiṃcana ||7|| nañ īṣadartham | atāpakairīṣattāpakaiṃ saurālokādisthānīyairviṣayairyoge sati manaṃ kiñcidavayavaviśaraṇamātraṃ prāpnoti | ataṃ śithilībhūte jatunīva tādṛśe manasi na kiñcidvastu vāsanātvena viśati | kintu vāsanāvailakṣaṇyena tadābhāsatvenaiva viśatītyartham ||7|| dravatāyāṃ praviṣṭaṃ sadyatkāṭhinyadaśāṃ gatam | cetaṃ punardrutau satyāmapi tannaiva muñcati ||8|| cittadrutau bhavati vāsanā, śithilībhāve tu vāsanābhāsa ityatra vinigamakamāha -- dravatāyāmiti | dravāvasthāpraviṣṭahiṅgulādiraṅgasya jatunaṃ punaṃ kāṭhinyāpanayena kāṣṭhādisaṃyoge jāyamāne yathā sa eva raṅgaṃ pratibhāsate, śaithilyāvasthāpraviṣṭastu raṅgo na tathā | evaṃ dravāvasthe cetasi yadvastusvarūpaṃ praviṣṭaṃ satkāṭhinyadaśāparyantaṃ sthitaṃ tatpunardravībhāvāntareṇa viṣayāntare gṛhyamāṇe'pi prakāśamānatvāccetasā na tyajyate | ataṃ sā vāsanetyucyate śaithilyāvasthāpraviṣṭaṃ tu kāṭhinyāvasthāparyantaṃ na tiṣṭhati | tiṣṭhadvā viṣayāntaragrahaṇasamaye cittena tyajyata iti sa vāsanābhāsa ityartham | ata eva yasyaikadā drute citte bhagavadākāratā praviṣṭā, sa sarvadā tadbhānātkṛtakṛtyo bhavatītyuktam -- sarvabhūteṣu yaṃ paśyedbhagavadbhāvamātmanam | bhūtāni bhagavatyātmanyeṣa bhāgavatottamam || iti | sarvabhūtagrahaṇasamaye'pi dravāvasthāpraviṣṭabhagavadākāratāyā eva prakāśamānatvājjaturaṅgavatsarvabhūteṣu bhagavadbhānopapattim | sa ca bhāgavatottamam, etādṛśasaṃskārasyāvināśitvāditi bhāvam | ata eva brahmavidevaitādṛśa ityapāstam | tasya brahmavido dravāvasthāyā anapekṣitatvenottamamadhyamaprākṛtabhakteṣvagaṇanīyatvāta| atra tu dravāvasthāparipuṣṭau sarvabhūteṣu yaṃ paśyedityavasthāyāṃ bhāgavatottama uktam | īṣaddravāvasthāyutānvāsanābhāsena -- īśvare tadadhīneṣu bāliśeṣu dviṣatsu ca | premamaitrīkṛpopekṣā yaṃ karoti sa madhyamam || ityuktam | etādṛgavasthāvato'gre dravāvasthāyā utpatsyamānatvādityartham | yasya tu citte na dravāvasthā puṣṭā, nāpīṣadutpannā, kintu svayaṃ tadarthaṃ bhāgavatadharmānśraddhayānutiṣṭhati, sa kāṭhinyāvasthāvināśasāmagrīviśiṣṭam -- arcāyāmeva haraye pūjāṃ yaṃ śraddhayehate | na tadbhakteṣu cānyeṣu sa bhaktaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam || ityuktam | prakṛtirārambhastasyāṃ vartamānaṃ prākṛtam | sāmprataṃ prārabdhabhaktisādhanānuṣṭhāna ityartham | iyameva ca dravāvasthā praṇayānurāgasnehādiśabdairapi saṅkīrtyate | yathā -- visṛjati hṛdayaṃ na yasya sākṣād dhariravaśābhihito'pyaghaughanāśam | praṇayarasanayā dhṛtāṅghripadmam sa bhavati bhāgavatapradhāna uktam || praṇayo dravāvasthā sa eva raśanā rajjuvadbandhanasādhanam | tasyāṃ dravāvasthāyāṃ praviṣṭasya punarnirgamanābhāvādityartham | dravāvasthāpraviṣṭabhagavatsvarūpabhānasya trividhatvāduttamabhāgavato'pi trividham | tatrādyaṃ prapañcasatyatvabhānasahitam, yathā -- khaṃ vāyumagniṃ salilaṃ mahīṃ ca jyotīṃṣi sattvāni diśo drumādīna| saritsamudrāṃśca hareṃ śarīraṃ yatkiṃ ca bhūtaṃ praṇamedananyam || ityādi | anena prākṛto bhāgavatottamam | dvitīyaṃ prapañcamithyātvabhānasahitaṃ, yathā -- tasmādidaṃ jagadaśeṣamasatsvarūpaṃ svapnābhamastadhiṣaṇaṃ purudumkhadumkhaṃ | tvayyeva nityasukhabodhatanāvanante māyāta udyadapi yatsadivāvabhāti || anena madhyamo bhāgavatottamam | tṛtīyaṃ prakāradvayenāpi prapañcabhānarahitaṃ, yathā -- dhyāyataścaraṇāmbhojaṃ bhāvanirjitacetasā | autkaṇṭhyāśrukalākṣasya hṛdyāsīnme śanairharim || premātibharanirbhinna pulakāṅgo'tinirvṛtam | ānandasamplave līno nāpaśyamubhayaṃ mune || anenottamo bhāgavatottamam | nirantarasādhanābhyāsaparipākeṇottamabhūmilābham ||8|| sthāyibhāvagirā'to'sau vastvākāro'bhidhīyate | vyaktaśca rasatāmeti parānandatayā punam ||9|| dravāvasthāpraviṣṭaviṣayākārasyānapāyitve sthāyiśabdo'pi tatra mukhya eva na pāribhāṣika ityāha -- sthāyīti | vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogenābhivyaktaṃ sthāyibhāva eva sabhyābhineyayorbhedatirodhānena sabhyagata eva sanparamānandasākṣātkārarūpeṇa rasatāmāpnotīti rasavidāṃ maryādā | taduktamācāryabharatena -- vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogādrasaniṣpattimiti | ato bhakterapi rasatāṃ vaktuṃ sthāyibhāvo nirūpyata iti bhāvam ||9|| bhagavānparamānandasvarūpaṃ svayameva hi | manogatastadākāro rasatāmeti puṣkalam ||10|| sthāyibhāvasya rasatvopapattaye paramānandarūpatāmupapādayati -- bhagavāniti | bimbameva hyupādhiniṣṭhatvena pratīyamānaṃ pratibimbamityucyate | paramānandaśca bhagavānmanasi pratibimbitasthāyibhāvatāmāsādya rasatāmāsādayatīti bhaktirasasya paramānandarūpatvaṃ nirvivādam | nāpyālambanavibhāvasthāyibhāvayoraikyam, bimbapratibimbabhāvena bhedasya vyavahārasiddhatvādīśajīvayoriva ||10|| kāntādiviṣaye'pyasti kāraṇaṃ sukhaciddhanam | kāryākāratayā'bhāne'pyāvṛtaṃ māyayā svatam ||11|| nanvevaṃ bhagavadākārasya paramānandarūpasya sthāyibhāvatvena bhaktirasasya paramānandarūpatvamastu | kāntādiviṣayāṇāṃ tu śṛṅgārādirasāṇāmatathātvātkathaṃ paramānandarūpametyata āha -- kāntādīti | ānandāddhyeva khalvimāni bhūtāni jāyante | ānandena jātāni jīvanti | ānandaṃ prayantyabhisaṃviśanti ityādi śrutyā hi paramānandarūpaṃ brahma jagadupādānamiti pratipāditam | janmādyasya yataṃ iti nyāyena tathaiva nirṇītam | upādānābhinnaṃ ca sarvaṃ kāryaṃ mṛdabhinnaghaṭavatsarvatra dṛṣṭam | sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma, idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā, sadeva somyedamagra āsīt ityādi cchāndogyādiśrutibhiśca tathaiva pradipāditam | tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhya iti nyāyena ca nirṇītam | evaṃ satyakhaṇḍānandādvayākāreṇa tadabhāne hetū māyānimittāvāvaraṇavikṣepāvityāha -- kāryeti | akāryasyāpi kāryākāreṇa bhānaṃ vikṣepam | akhaṇḍānandākāreṇa svato'bhānvamāvaraṇam | taduktam -- ṛte'rthaṃ yatpratīyeta na pratīyeta cātmani | tadvidyādātmano māyāṃ yathābhāso yathā tamam || iti ||11|| sadajñātaṃ ca tadbrahma meyaṃ kāntādimānatam | māyāvṛttitirobhāve vṛttyā sattvasthayā kṣaṇam ||12|| kathaṃ tarhi tasya bhānamityata āha -- saditi | ajñātajñāpakatvenaiva hi sarveṣāṃ mānānāṃ mānatā, anyathā smṛterapi mānatāpattem | ajñātaṃ ca svaprakāśatayā bhāsamānacaitanyameva na jaḍam | tasya bhānāprasaktyā tatrāvaraṇakṛtyābhāvāta| ataṃ kāntādigocaramānānāmajñātajñāpakatvena prāmāṇyāya tattadavicchinnacaitanyameva viṣayo vācyam, anyathā tadayogāta| tathā ca sāttvikyā pramāṇajanitāparokṣavṛttyāvaraṇatirobhāve sati tattadviṣayāvacchinnatvena bhāsate | vastutaṃ paramānandarūpaviṣayopādānacaitanyam | anavacchinnasvarūpābhānācca na sadyomuktiṃ svaprakāśatvabhaṅgo vā ||12|| atastadeva bhāvatvaṃ manasi pratipadyate | kiṃ ca nyūnāṃ ca rasatāṃ yāti jāḍyavimiśraṇāta||13|| tataṃ kiṃ ? ata āha -- ata iti | viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyameva dravāvasthamanovṛttyārūḍhatayā bhāvatvaṃ prāpya rasatāṃ prāpnotīti na laukikarasasyāpi paramānandarūpatvānupapattim | ata evānavacchinnacidānandaghanasya bhagavataṃ sphuraṇādbhaktirase'tyantādhikyamānandasya | laukikarase tu viṣayāvacchinnasyaiva cidānandāṃśasyāsphuraṇāttatrānandasya nyūnataiva | tasmādbhaktirasa eva laukikarasānupekṣya sevya ityartham ||13|| iti vedāntasiddhānte sthāyino rasatoditā | sāṅkhyasiddhāntamāśrityāpyadhunā pratipadyate ||14|| pratipādyata iti | sthāyinā rasatetyanuṣaṅgam ||14|| tamorajamsattvaguṇā mohadumkhasukhātmakām | tanmayī prakṛtirhetuṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ ca tanmayam ||15|| etāvadevopapādayituṃ vyutpādayati -- tamorajamsattveti | tathā hi sāṅkhyā evamācakṣate -- sarve bhāvāṃ sukhadumkhamohātmakasāmānyaprakṛtikām | sukhadumkhamohātmakatvena pratīyamānatvāta| ye yadātmakatvena pratīyante te tadātmakasāmānyaprakṛtikām | yathā, mṛdātmakatayā pratīyamānā mṛtsāmānyaprakṛtikā ghaṭaśarāvādayam | anugatakāraṇātiriktasāmānyānabhyupagamamānna ghaṭatvādinā vyabhicāram | sukhadumkhamohātmakatvena caite pratīyante | tasmāttatsāmānyaprakṛtikā ityanumānena sukhadumkhātmakaprakṛtisiddhim | tatra yatsukhaṃ tatsattvam | yaddumkhaṃ tadrajo, yo moho viṣādaṃ sa tama iti tasyāstriguṇātmakatvasiddhim | na ca paramāṇubhirbrahmaṇā cārthāntaratā, paramāṇuvāde kāryakāraṇayorbhedābhyupagamena teṣāmatīndriyatvena ca tadātmakatayā kasyāpi kāryasya pratīyamānatvābhāvātparamāṇuṣu pramāṇābhāvācca | sargādyakālīnakāryopādānānumānasya lāghavatarkasahakāreṇaikopādānaviṣayakatvātkṣityādikartranumānasyaikakartṛviṣayakatvavata| brahmavādināṃ kāryakāraṇayorabhedābhyupagame'pi na jagato brahmātmanā pratīyamānatvaṃ sambhavati, brahmaṇaṃ sārvalaukikamānāgocaratvābhyupagamāta| sadrūpeṇa brahmāpi sarvapramāṇāgocaram | tathā ca sadātmanā kāryasya pratīyamānatvamastyeveti cet, kimanenākāṇḍatāṇḍavena ? brahmaṇo nimsāmānyaviśeṣatvena nānārūpāsambhava iti sāṅkhyasaṅkhyāvatāmabhimānam ||15|| triguṇātmakamekaikaṃ vastu tryākāramīkṣyate | nijamānasasaṅkalpabhedena puruṣaistribhim ||16|| nanu bhavatāmapyasiddho hetum, sukhadumkhamohanāmāntarāṇāṃ bāhyaghaṭāditādātmyasambhavāta| sambhave vā sarvaṃ vastu sarvaṃ pramātāraṃ prati tryākāratayā prathetetyata āha -- triguṇeti | na tāvadāntarabāhyayostādātmyasambhavam | bāhyānāmeva manampratibimbitatvenāntaratvāta| nāpi sarvānprati tulyabhānaprasaṅgam | tattadvāsanārūpasahakāribhedāta||16|| kāminyāṃ sukhatā bhartrā sapatnyā dumkharūpatā | tadalābhāttathānyena mohatvamanubhūyate ||17|| etadevodāharati -- kāminyā iti | bhartāraṃ prati hi kāminyāṃ sattvāṃśa evodricyate | sapatnīṃ prati tu rajo'ṃśa eva | tāṃ kāmayamānamanyaṃ ca tāmavindantaṃ prati tamo'ṃśa eva | ataṃ krameṇa teṣu sukhadumkhaviṣādāṃ prārdubhavantyato vyavasthopapattim | vāsanābhedenaikasminnapi bhānabhedo bhaṭṭācāryairapyuktam -- parivrāṭkāmukaśunāmekasyāṃ pramadātanau | kuṇapaṃ kāminī bhakṣyamiti tisro vikalpanām || iti ||17|| evaṃ sati sukhākāraṃ praviṣṭo mānase yadā | tadā sa sthāyibhāvatvaṃ pratipadya raso bhaveta||18|| phalitamāha -- evaṃ satīti | krodhādibhāvasyāpi rajastamomiśritasattvodrekanibandhanacittadrutiphalitatvātsukhamayatvamityabhiprāyam | dravībhāvasya sattvadharmatvāttaṃ vinā ca sthāyibhāvāsambhavātsattvaguṇasya ca sukhamayatvātsarveṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ sukhamayatve'pi rajastamo'ṃśamiśraṇāttāratamyamavagantavyam | ato na sarveṣu raseṣu tulyasukhānubhavam | upariṣṭācca spaṣṭīkariṣyate ||18|| paramāṇvekarūpaṃ tu cittaṃ na viṣayākṛti | ityādi matamanyeṣāmaprāmāṇyādupekṣitam ||19|| atrāhustārkikām -- nityaṃ niravayavamaṇuparimāṇaṃ manam | tasya kathaṃ sāvayavajatudṛṣṭāntena dravībhāvadvārā viṣayākārapariṇāmo vaktuṃ śakyate ? na hi niravayavasya hrāsavṛddhī sambhavatam | tasmāduktasthāyibhāvanirūpaṇamasaṅgatamiti | tatrāha -- parameti | ādiśabdādvibhurmana iti prābhākarāṇāṃ, samanantarapratyaya evottarajñānakāraṇatayā mana iti saugatānāṃ ca mataṃ saṅgṛhītam | ayaṃ bhāvam -- karaṇatvātparaśvādivadindriyatvāccakṣurādivanmanaso madhyamaparimāṇatvamanumīyate | na cāṇutvānumāne kiṃcilliṅgamasti | nāpi nityendriyatvācchortravadvibhutvānumānam, nityatvasyāsiddhatvāta| ākāśasyāpi nityatvābhāvena tatkāryaśrotrasya sutarāṃ nityatvābhāvācca | ata eva janyasya vibhutvābhāvānmadhyamaparimāṇatvānumānasya śrotre na vyabhicāram | yadindriyaṃ yadguṇagrāhakaṃ tadindriyaṃ tadguṇavadbhūtārabdhamiti vyāpteryathā cakṣurādeṃ svagrāhyaguṇavadbhūtārabhyatvaṃ sādhyate tathā manaso'pi pañcamahābhūtaguṇagrāhakatvena svagrāhyaguṇavatpañcabhūtārabhyatvaṃ sādhyatām, viśeṣābhāvāta| na ca vijātīyānāmanārambhakatvaṃ viśeṣam, suvarṇasūtraiṃ paṭṭasūtraiṃ kārpāsasūtraiśca vijātīyairekapaṭārambhadarśanāta| tatrāvayavyanaṅgīkāre'nyatrāpi tathānaṅgīkārasambhavādavayavino tattajalāñjalitāprasaṅgāta| tasmādapañcīkṛtapañcabhūtārabdhaṃ sattvapradhānaṃ saṅkocavikāsaśīlaṃ svacchadravyaṃ cakṣurvanmūrtadravya'bhighātayogyaṃ ca dehaparimāṇaṃ mano'bhyupagantavyam, siddhānte sukhadumkhecchājñānādīnāṃ tadāśrayatvābhyupagamātteṣāṃ ca sarvaśarīravyāpitvenopalambhāttadāśrayasya manaso'pi sarvaśarīravyāpitvāta| aṇutvābhāve yugapatsarvendriyeṇaikadaikameva jñānaṃ janyata iti niyamastāvadāvayoṃ samam | anyathā yugapaccākṣuṣajñānadvayotpattiṃ kiṃ na syāt? nānendriyajanyajñānānāṃ tu yugapadutpattiriṣyata eva, dīrghāṃ śuṣkulīṃ bhakṣayataṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhānāṃ yugapadanubhavāta| suṣuptyanyathānupapattyā tvaṅmanamsaṃyogasya jñānamātre kāraṇatvena tvayābhyupagamādrasanāvacchinnatvaksaṃyuktasya guḍasya yugapadrasasparśopalambhastavāpi durnivāram | tasmānnāsmadabhyupagate manasi śrutismṛtinyāyasiddhe vimatiṃ sambhavati | samanantarapratyayastvatiniryuktikatvādupekṣitam | vistarastvasmadīyavedāntakalpalatāyāmanusandheyam ||19|| gṛhṇāti viṣayākāraṃ mano viṣayayogatam | iti vedāntibhiṃ sāṅkhyairapi samyaṅnirūpitam ||20|| ataṃ svacchasvabhāvasya sāvayavasya manaso darpaṇādivadviṣayākāragrāhakatvaṃ vedāntaśāstre sāṅkhyaśāstre ca yannirūpitam, tatprāmāṇikatvātsamīcīnamevetyāha -- gṛhṇātīti | yadyapi sāṅkhyānāmāhaṅkārikaṃ manaṃ brahmavādināṃ tu mate bhautikamiti mahānviśeṣastathāpi viṣayākāragrāhakatvaṃ samānamiti tulyavadubhayorupanyāsam ||20|| mūṣāsiktaṃ yathā tāmraṃ tannibhaṃ dṛśyate tathā | ghaṭādi vyāpnuvaccittaṃ tannibhaṃ jāyate dhruvam ||21|| dravībhāvapūrvakaṃ cittasya viṣayākārabhajanamityatra bhāṣyakāravacanamudāharati -- mūṣeti | mūṣā puṭapākayantram | taddvārā dravībhūtaṃ tāmraṃ yatra pratimādyākāraghaṭitodare mṛdādisaṃsthānaviśeṣe siktaṃ bhavati, tattadudarasthasaṃsthānākāraṃ bhavati drutatvāta| eva rāgadveṣādinā dravībhūtaṃ cittaṃ cakṣurādidvārā yatra siktaṃ bhavati svayamapi tadviṣayākāraṃ bhavatīti kārikārtham | yadyapyasminvākye sāmānyata eva dravībhāva uktastathāpyanubhavabalādrāgadveṣādiviṣaye vyavasthāpyate, tadabhāve tu śithilībhāvamātramityuktamadhastāta||21|| vyañjako vā yathā''loko vyaṅyasyākāratāmiyāta| sarvārthavyañjakatvāddhīrarthākārā pradṛśyate ||22|| mano viṣayākāram | viṣayagatāvaraṇanivartakatvādālokavadityanumānamasminnarthe pramāṇamāha -- vyañjako veti | vyañjakasya tadākāratvābhāve tadgatāvaraṇanivṛtteradarśanādityartham ||22|| bhagavatpūjyapādānāmiyamuktiṃ sayuktikā | tathā vārtikakārai apyayamartho nirūpitam ||23|| bhagavaditi | vyañjako vetyādyuktirvārtikakārāṇāmapi | yuktiranumānarūpā darśitā ||23|| māturmānābhiniṣpattirniṣpannaṃ meyameti tata| meyābhisaṅgataṃ tacca meyābhatvaṃ prapadyate ||24|| vārtikakārāṇāṃ vākyāntaramudāharati -- māturiti | mātuścidacidgranthrūpātsacitkādantamkaraṇātvṛttijñānākhyasya dravībhāvapūrvakasya mānśabdavācyasya parṇāmaviśeṣasyābhiniṣpattirbhavati | tacca pariṇāmaviśeṣātmakaṃ mānaniṣpannaṃ saccakṣurādidvārā ghaṭādiviṣayaparyantaṃ gacchati śarīrāvacchinnamantamkaraṇamatyajadeva kulyājalavata| tacca ghaṭādisambaddhaṃ sadghaṭādyākāratāṃ prāpnoti | tataśca tatra caitanyābhivyaktyā ghaṭādyupalabha iti kārikārtham | sarvā ceyaṃ prakriyāsmābhirvistareṇa siddhāntabindau pratipāditā ||24|| evametādṛśaṃ vākyamudāhāryamanekaśam | cittasya viṣayākāragrāhakatvopapādane ||25|| evamiti | granthagauravabhayānnodāhriyata iti bhāvam ||25|| ato māṃsamayī yoṣitkācidanyā manomayī | māṃsamayyā abhede'pi bhidyate'tra manomayī ||26|| pañcadaśyāṃ vidyāraṇyapādairapyayamartho darśitam | tamupasaṃhāravyājenāha -- ato māṃsamayīti | manomayyākārabhedaṃ vinaikasminbhautike piṇḍe bhedapratyayāyogādityartham ||26|| bhāryā snuṣā nanāndā ca yātā mātetyanekadhā | jāmātā śvaśuraṃ putraṃ pitetyādi pumānapi ||27|| bhedapratītimeva sarvasiddhāmudāharati -- bhāryeti | bhidyate ityanuṣaṅgam ||27|| bāhyapiṇḍasya nāśe'pi tiṣṭhatyeva manomayam | ataṃ sthāyīti vidvadbhirayameva nirūpitam ||28|| ekānekatvavaidharmyamuktvā vināśitvāvināśitvavaidharmyāntaramāha -- bāhyeti | manomayo'vyavahita evetyartham ||28|| evaṃ sāmānyato bhāvasvarūpamupadarśitam | viśeṣeṇa tu sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate pṛthaka||29|| manomayī viṣayākāra evāvināśitvātsthāyibhāva iti kathitam | tasya tu ratihāsādirūpeṇa bhadestallakṣaṇaṃ ca vakṣyate'nantarollāsa ityartham ||29|| bhagavantaṃ vibhuṃ nityaṃ pūrṇaṃ bodhasukhātmakam | yadgṛhṇāti drutaṃ cittaṃ kimanyadavaśiṣyate ||30|| yasmāddrutacittapraviṣṭo viṣayākāro'napāyī, tasmādityāha -- bhagavantamityādi | vibhumiti sarvadeśavyāpakatvam | nityamiti sarvakālavyāpakatvam | pūrṇamityadvitīyatayā sarvadvaitabhramādhiṣṭhānatvam | bodhasukhātmakamiti niratiśayapumarthatvaṃ darśitam | etādṛśena bhagavadākāreṇa manogatenānādikālapraviṣṭāsaṅkhyaviṣayākārāṇāṃ kavalīkaraṇāttanmātraparisphūrtyā kṛtakṛtyo bhavatītyartham ||30|| kaṭhinā śithilā vā dhīrna gṛhṇāti na vāsyate | upekṣājñānamityāhustadbudhāṃ prastarādiṣu ||31|| dravībhāvasya prayojanaṃ pūrvoktameva smārayati tatra prayatnadāṛḍhyāya -- kaṭhineti | kaṭhinā dhīrna gṛhṇātyeva | śithilā tu gṛhṇātyapi na vāsyate dravībhāvābhāvaditaṃ pūrvamevoktam | īṣadapyadravībhāvaṃ kāṭhinyamīṣaddravatvaṃ śaithilyam | tacca dravāvasthākāryabhūtasāttvikabhāvābhāvādavaseyam | te ca -- stambhaṃ svedo'tha romāñcāṃ svarabhaṅgo'tha vepathum | vaivarṇyamaśru pralaya ityaṣṭau sāttvikā matām || ityabhihitām | ata eva bhagavadviṣaye kāṭhinyaṃ nigadyate -- tadaśmasāraṃ hṛdayaṃ batedaṃ yadgṛhyamāṇairharināmadheyaim | na vikriyetātha yadā vikāro netre jalaṃ gātraruheṣu harṣam || kathaṃ vinā romaharṣaṃ dravatā cetasā vinā | vinānandāśrukalayā śudhyedbhaktyā vināśayam || bhaktyā vinā kathamāśayaṃ śudhyet? bhaktiśca dravatā cetasā vinā kathaṃ syāt? dravaccittaṃ ca kathaṃ romaharṣaṃ vinā''nandāśru ca vinā jñāyetetyartham | aśrupulakayorabhidhānaṃ stambhasvedādīnāmapyupalakṣaṇam | yato dravatvābhāve cittaṃ na vāsyate | ato budhāṃ paṇḍitāṃ kāmakrodhādyanāspadībhūtāpāṣāṇādijñānamupekṣājñānasaṃskārājanakamityāhum | tathā cāhurnyāyavārttikakṛtam -- yanna sukhasādhanaṃ na dumkhasādhanaṃ, tadevopekṣaṇīyamiti | sukhasādhane rāgaṃ saṃskāraheturdumkhasādhane dveṣastathā tadubhayābhāve tu citte dravatvābhāvānna jāyate saṃskāra ityartham | etāvānhi sarveṣāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ rahasyabhūto'rtho yadviṣayākāratānirākaraṇapūrvakaṃ cittasya bhagavadākāratāsampādanam, sarveṣāmapi śāstrāṇāmatraiva vyāpārabhedena paryavasānāta||31|| kāṭhinyaṃ viṣaye kuryāddravataṃ bhagavatpade | upāyaiṃ śāstranirdiṣṭairanukṣaṇamato budham ||32|| nanvanādikāladravaccittapraviṣṭatattadiṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayakoṭisaṅkīrṇatā cittasya svabhāvabhūtā śītateva toyasyoṣṇateva dahanasya sañcariṣṇuteva pavanasya kathaṃ nivartatāṃ, dharmiṇi sati svabhāvopamardāsmabhavādityata āha -- kāṭhinyamiti | viṣayākāratā hi na cittasya svabhāvabhūtā, tasyā āgantukahetujanyatvāta| tathā hi -- sthūlaviṣayākāratāheturindriyasannikarṣādirjāgaraṇe, sūkṣmaviṣayākāratāheturmanogatavāsanā svapne, tadubhayābhāve tu suṣuptivannirviṣayameva cittaṃ bhavati | suṣuptau cittalayābhidhānaṃ tu nirviṣayakatvābhiprāyakameva | etacca bhagavatā sūtrakāreṇaiva pradarśitam -- tadā'pīteṃ saṃsāravyapadeśāt | apītirlayam | maryādāyāmāṅa| apītiṃ layaṃ maryādīkṛtya, tasya manaso layātpūrvakāle saṃsāravyapadeśam | na tu tallaye satīti sūtrārtham | tathā ca suṣuptāvapi punarutthānena saṃsāravyapadeśasya sattvānna manolayam | vivaraṇakārāṇāṃ tu keyaṃ sūkṣmatā nāma ityādinā yanmanolayābhidhānaṃ, tatparamatābhiprāyeṇa na tu svamatānusāreṇa sūtravirodhātiti bhāvam | bhagavadākāratā tu cittasya svābhāvikī tasya cittakāraṇībhūtasūkṣmakāraṇānirvacanīyavicitrānekaśaktimanmāyādhiṣṭhānasya nityasya vibhoṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ sarvatrānugatatvāt, yathā ghaṭasya jalādipūrṇatā kāraṇasādhyā, ākāśapūrṇatā tu svatam, tasya sarvavyāpakatvāt, tadvata| taduktaṃ vārtikākārapādaim -- viyadvastusvabhāvānurodhādeva na kārakāta| viyatsampūrṇatotpattau kumbhasyaivaṃ daśā dhiyām || sukhadumkhādirūpatvaṃ dhiyāṃ dharmādihetutam | svataṃ siddhātmasambodhavyāptirvastvanurodhatam || iti | cittasya bhagavadākāratāyāṃ svābhāvikatvena hetvanapekṣāyā śāstrasya kopayoga iti cedanyākāratāvirodhibhagavadākāratāsampādana ityavehi | yā hi svābhāvikī bhagavadākāratā cittasya, sā viṣayākāratāsahacaritatvāttatsadhakatvācca na tadvirodhinī | śāstrajanyā tu sādhanopakrame parokṣeva bhāsamānābhyāsakrameṇa viṣayākāratāṃ śanaiṃ śanaistirodadhatī sādhanaparipākeṇāparokṣatāṃ nītā satī tāṃ samūlaghātamupahanti | ata evoktam -- yarhyabjanābhacaraṇaiṣaṇayorubhaktyā cetomalāni vidhamedguṇakarmajāni | tasminviśuddha upalabhyata ātmatattvaṃ sākṣādyathāmaladṛśoṃ savitṛprakāśam || yathāgninā hema malaṃ jahāti dhmātaṃ punaṃ svaṃ bhajate ca rūpam | ātmā ca karmānuśayaṃ vidhūya madbhaktiyogena bhajatyatho mām || yathā yathātmā parimṛjyate'sau matpuṇyagāthāśravaṇābhidhānaim | tathā tathā paśyati vastu sūkṣmaṃ cakṣuryathaivāñjanasamprayuktam || viṣayāndhyāyataścittaṃ viṣayeṣu viṣajjate | māmanusmarataścittaṃ mayyeva pravilīyate || tasmādasadabhidhyānaṃ yathā svapnamanoratham | hitvā mayi samādhatsva mano madbhāvabhāvitam || etāvānyoga ādiṣṭo macchiṣyaiṃ sanakādibhim | sarvato mana ākṛṣya mayyaddhāveśyate manam || sa ca śrīkapiladevenoktam -- animittanimittena svadharmeṇāmalātmanā | tīvrayā mayi bhaktyā ca śrutasambhṛtayā ciram || jñānena dṛṣṭatattvena vairāgyeṇa balīyasā | tapoyuktena yogena tīvreṇātmasamādhinā || prakṛtiṃ puruṣasyeha dahyamānā tvaharniśam | tirobhavitrī śanakairagneryonirivāraṇim || prakṛtiṃ svābhāvikī viṣayākāratetyartham | haṃsagītāsu ca -- guṇeṣvāviśate ceto guṇāścetasi ca prabho | kathamanyonyasantyāgo mukukṣoratititīrṣom || iti sanakādipraśnasyottaraṃ bhagavānuvāca -- manasā vacasā dṛṣṭyā gṛhyate'nyairapīndriyaim | ahameva na matto'nyaditi budhyadhvamañjasā || jāgratsvapnaṃ suṣuptaṃ ca guṇato buddhivṛttayam | tāsāṃ vilakṣaṇo jīvaṃ sākṣitvena viniścitam || yarhi saṃsṛtibandho'yamātmano guṇavṛttidam | mayi turye sthito jahyāttyāgastadguṇacetasām || ahaṅkārakṛtaṃ bandhamātmano'rthaviparyayam | vidvānnirvidya saṃsāra cintāṃ turye sthitastyajeta|| yāvannānārthadhīṃ puṃso na nivarteta yuktibhim | jāgartyapi svapannajñaṃ svapne jāgaraṇaṃ yathā || asattvādātmano'nyeṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ tatkṛtā bhidā | gatayo hetavaścāsya mṛṣā svapnadṛśo yathā || yo jāgare bahiranukṣaṇadharmiṇo'rthān bhuṅkte samastakaraṇairhṛdi tatsadṛkṣāna| svapne suṣupta upasaṃharate sa ekam smṛtyanvayāttriguṇavṛttidṛgindriyeśam || evaṃ vimṛśya guṇato manasastryavasthā manmāyayā mayi kṛtā iti niścitārthām | sañchidya hārdamanumānasaduktitīkṣṇa jñānāsinā bhajata mākhilasaṃśayādhim || evaṃ jijñāsayāpohya nānātvabhramamātmani | upārameta virajaṃ mano mayyarpya sarvage || ityādi | ayamatra niṣkarṣam -- citte svākārasamarpakā ye viṣayāste bhagavadvyatiriktā na bhavanti, bhagavatyadhyastatvāta| bhagavata eva sadrūpatayā ghaṭaṃ sanpaṭaṃ sannityādisadākāreṇaiva sarvaviṣayāṇāṃ sphuraṇāta| sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalān iti śrutyā bhagavadekodbhavatvena bhagavadekasthititvena bhagavadekalayatvena ca mṛdghaṭavadabodhanāta| svapnādiprapañcavadbādhyatvācca | ata eva bhagavadākārasphūrtyā te sarve nivartamānāstadrūpā eva bhavanti, adhiṣṭhānajñānanivartyatvādadhyastānām | evaṃ ca sati viṣayaniṣṭhaṃ sarvo'pi premā bhagavatyevārpito bhavati, tadvyatiriktāsphuraṇāta| etādṛśī cāvasthā prahlādena prārthitā -- yā prītiravivekānāṃ viṣayeṣvanapāyinī | tvāmanusmarataṃ sā me hṛdayānnāpasarpatu || iti | tasmādetādṛśayuktyanusandhānena sarvādhiṣṭhānasanmātraṃ paripūrṇasaccidānandaghanaṃ bhagavantamadvayamātmānaṃ niścinvantaṃ svāpnikaviṣayeṣviva jāgradviṣayeṣvapi tucchatvānusandhānena vairāgyaṃ mahadupajāyate vaśīkārākhyam | etacca sūtritaṃ bhagavatā patañjalinā -- dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayavitṛṣṇasya vaśīkārasaṃjñā vairāgyaṃ iti | caturvidhaṃ hi vairāgyaṃ sādhyasādhanabhāvāpannamāgamaprasiddham | tatra mahatā prayāsenāpi cittadoṣānavaśyaṃ nirākariṣyāmītyadhyavasāyātmakaṃ prathamaṃ yatamānasaṃjñāvairāgyam | tato nirantaramupāyānuṣṭhāne kriyamāṇa etāvanto doṣā idānīṃ kṣīṇā etāvantaścāvaśiṣyanta iti cikitsakavatpratikṣaṇamavadhānaṃ dvitīyaṃ vyatirekasaṃjñāvairāgyam | evaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ bhūmikādvayābhyāsaṃ kurvataṃ sarvatobhāvena bahirindriyāṇāṃ viṣayeṣvapravṛttiryā'ntamkaraṇe vāsanāyāṃ satyāmapi, sā tṛtīyamekendriyasaṃjñāvairāgyam | evaṃ bhūmikātrayābhyāsāddṛṣṭeṣu vanitādiṣvānuśravikeṣu svargādiṣu cendriyairgṛhyamāṇeṣvapi doṣadarśanaparipākajanyāspṛhātmikā yā cittavṛttiṃ sā caturthaṃ vaśīkārasaṃjñāvairāgyam | tadapi dvividhamaparaṃ paraṃ ca | dvitīyaṃ sūtritaṃ patañjalinā -- tatparaṃ puruṣakhyāterguṇavaitṛṣṇyaṃ iti | puruṣakhyātirātmajñānam | tadanantaraṃ yatguṇeṣu śabdādiviṣayeṣu vaitṛṣṇyaṃ vairāgyaṃ tatparaṃ śreṣṭham, phalarūpatvāta| tataṃ pūrvaṃ tvaparam, sādhanarūpatvādityartham | tasya ca liṅgamitaraphalanirapekṣatvena mokṣamātraspṛhayālutvam | yathā mucukundasya -- na kāmaye'nyaṃ tava pādasevanād akiñcanaprārthyatamādvaraṃ vibho | ārādhya kastvāmapavargadaṃ hare vṛṇīta āryo varamātmabandhanam || tasmādvisṛjyāśiṣa īśa sarvato rajastamamsattvaguṇānubandhām | nirañjanaṃ nirguṇamadvayaṃ paraṃ tvāṃ jñaptimātraṃ puruṣaṃ vrajāmyaham || ciramiha vṛjinārtastapyamāno'nutāpair avitṛṣaṣaḍamitro'labdhaśāntiṃ kathañcita| aśaraṇada samupetastvatpadābjaṃ parātman abhayamamṛtamaśokaṃ pāhi māpannamīśa || etādṛśadaśāyāṃ ca bhagavatpremā na parākāṣṭhāmadhirohatīti tadarthaṃ taṃ prati bhagavatoktam -- kṣātradharmasthito jantūnnyavadhīrmṛgayādibhim | samāhitastattapasā jahyaghaṃ madupāśritam || janmanyanantare rājansarvabhūtasuhṛttamam | bhūtvā dvijavarastvaṃ vai māmupaiṣyasi kevalam || iti | aparavairāgyaṃ ca sūtritaṃ patañjalinā -- dṛṣṭānuśravikaviṣayavitṛṣṇasya vaśīkārasaṃjñā vairāgyaṃ iti | tena na premaparamākāṣṭheti na tadānīmeva kṛtārthatā, paravairāgyābhāvena bhaktiprakarṣābhāvāta| tasyaiva kṛtakṛtyatāhetutvādityartham | paravairāgyasya liṅgaṃ mokṣaparyantasakalaphalanirapekṣatvam, yathā -- imaṃ lokaṃ tathaivāmumātmānamubhayāyinam | ātmānamanu ye ceha ye rāyaṃ paśavo gṛhām || visṛjya sarvānanyāṃśca māmevaṃ viśvatomukham | bhajantyananyayā bhaktyā tānmṛtyoratipāraye || sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpya sārūpyaikatvamapyuta | dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vinā matsevanaṃ janām || naikātmatāṃ me spṛhayanti kecin matpādasevābhiratā madīhām | ye'nyonyato bhāgavatāṃ prasajya sabhājayante mama pauruṣāṇi || na pārameṣṭhyaṃ na mahendradhiṣṇyaṃ na sārvabhaumaṃ na rasādhipatyam | na yogasiddhīrapunarbhavaṃ vā mayyarpitātmecchati madvinānyata|| prahlādam -- ahaṃ tvakāmastvadbhaktastvaṃ ca svāmyanapāśrayam | nānyathehāvayorartho rājasevakayoriva || pṛthum -- na kāmaye nātha tadapyahaṃ kvacin na yatra yuṣmaccaraṇāmbujāsavam | mahattamāntarhṛdayānmukhacyuto vidhatsva karṇāyutameṣa me varam || dhruvam -- yā nirvṛtistanubhṛtāṃ tava pādapadma dhyānādbhavajjanakathāśravaṇena vā syāta| sā brahmaṇi svamahimanyapi nātha mā bhūt kiṃ tvantakāsilulitātpatatāṃ vimānāta|| mahiṣyam -- na vayaṃ sādhvi sāmrājyaṃ svārājyaṃ bhaujyamapyuta | vairājyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ ca ānantyaṃ vā hareṃ padam || kāmayāmaha etasya śrīmatpādarajaṃ śriyam | kucakuṅkumagandhāṭhyaṃ mūrdhnā voṭhuṃ gadābhṛtam || indram -- pratyānītāṃ parama bhavatā trāyatā naṃ svabhāgā daityākrāntaṃ hṛdayakamalaṃ tadgṛhaṃ pratyabodhi | kālagrastaṃ kiyadidamaho nātha śuśrūṣatāṃ te muktisteṣāṃ na hi bahumatā nārasiṃhāparaiṃ kim || tathā -- yasya bhaktirbhagavati harau nimśreyaseśvare | vikrīḍato'mṛtāmbhodhau kiṃ kṣudraiṃ khātakodakaim || vṛtram -- na nākapṛṣṭhaṃ na ca pārameṣṭhyaṃ na sārvabhaumaṃ na rasādhipatyam | na yogasiddhīrapunarbhavaṃ vā samañjasa tvā virahayya kāṅkṣe || śrutayam -- duravagamātmatattvanigamāya tavāttatanoś caritamahāmṛtābdhiparivartapariśramaṇām | na parilaṣanti kecidapavargamapīśvara te caraṇasarojahaṃsakulasaṅgavisṛṣṭagṛhām || evamanyadapyūhanīyam | etādṛśe mokṣaparyantasakalaphalanirapekṣatvarūpe paravairāgye sati phalāntare premṇo'nudayātparamānandarūpe paramātmanyeva premā parāṃ kāṣṭhāmārohati | yathā vṛtrasya -- ajātapakṣā iva mātaraṃ khagām stanyaṃ yathā vatsatarāṃ kṣudhārtām | priyaṃ priyeva vyuṣitaṃ viṣaṇṇā mano'ravindākṣa didṛkṣate tvām || iti | ata eva jñānaṃ vinā paravairāgyābhāvāttadṛte ca bhagavatpremaparākāṣṭhābhāvāttadarthaṃ jñānavairāgye dṛḍhīkartavye | taduktam -- asevayāyaṃ prakṛterguṇānāṃ jñānena vairāgyavijṛmbhitena | yogena mayyarpitayā ca bhaktyā māṃ pratyagātmānamihāvarundhe || jñānavairāgyayuktena bhaktiyogena yoginam | kṣemāya pādamūlaṃ me praviśantyakutobhayam || ityacyutāṅghriṃ bhajato'nuvṛttyā bhaktirviraktirbhagavatprabodham | bhavanti vai bhāgavatasya rājaṃs tataṃ parāṃ śāntimupaiti sākṣāta|| bhāgavatasya bhagavaddharmānuṣṭhātuṃ prathamaṃ bhagavatprabodhastataṃ paraṃ vairāgyaṃ tataṃ premalakṣaṇā bhaktirityartham | etacca darśitamuddhavāya śrībhagavatā -- jñāninastvahameveṣṭaṃ svārtho hetuśca sammatam | svargaścaivāpavargaśca nānyo'rtho madṛte priyam || jñānavairāgyasaṃsiddhāṃ padaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidurmama | jñānī priyatamo'to me jñānenāsau bibharti mām || kīdṛśaṃ tajjñānamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ saṅkṣepeṇa taduktam -- tvayyuddhavāśrayati yastrividho vikāro māyāntarāpatati nādyapavargayoryata| janmādayo'sya yadamī tava tasya kiṃ syur ādyantayoryadasato'sti tadeva madhye || bhagavadvyatiriktaṃ sarvamāgamāpāyitvātsvapnavanmāyikaṃ tucchaṃ dumkharūpaṃ ca heyam | bhagavāneva satyaṃ svaprakāśaparamānandarūpo nityo vibhuścopādeya iti jñānamityartham | śrīmadbhagavadgītāsu ca tadevoktam -- teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate | priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyam || udārāṃ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam | āsthitaṃ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim || bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate | vāsudevaṃ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabham || iti | vāsudevātiriktaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ nāsti māyikatvāta| vāsudeva evātmatvātpriyatamaṃ satya ityartham | etādṛśajñānapūrvakavairāgyaṃ ca darśitam -- śrutiṃ pratyakṣamaitihyamanumānaṃ catuṣṭayam | pramāṇeṣvanavasthānādvikalpātsa virajyate || karmaṇāṃ pariṇāmitvādāviriñcyādamaṅgalam | vipaścinnaśvaraṃ paśyedadṛṣṭamapi dṛṣṭavata|| tathānyatra -- karmāṇyārabhamāṇānāṃ dumkhahatyai sukhāya ca | paśyetpākaviparyāsaṃ mithunīcāriṇāṃ nṛṇām || nityārtidena vittena durlabhenātmamṛtyunā | gṛhāpatyāptapaśubhiṃ kā prītiṃ sādhitaiścalaim || evaṃ lokaṃ paraṃ vidyānnaśvaraṃ karmanirmitam | satulyātiśayadhvaṃsaṃ yathā maṇḍalavartinām || kīdṛśī bhagavaddharmānuṣṭhāturjñānavairāgyapūrvikā bhagavati bhaktirudetītyākāṅkṣāyāmuktam -- yadyanīśo dhārayituṃ mano brahmaṇi niścalam | mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi nirapekṣaṃ samācara || śraddhālurmatkathāṃ śṛṇvansubhadrā lokapāvanīm | gāyannanusmarankarma janma cābhinayanmuhum || madarthe dharmakāmārthānācaranmadapāśrayam | labhate niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ mayyuddhava sanātane || tathā -- bhaktiyogaṃ puraivoktaṃ prīyamāṇāya te'nagha | punaśca kathayiṣyāmi madbhakteṃ kāraṇaṃ param || śraddhāmṛtakathāyāṃ me śaśvanmadanukīrtanam | pariniṣṭhā ca pūjāyāṃ stutibhiṃ stavanaṃ mama || ādaraṃ paricaryāyāṃ sarvāṅgairabhivandanam | madbhaktapūjābhyadhikā sarvabhūteṣu manmatim || madartheṣvaṅgaceṣṭā ca vacasā madguṇeraṇam | mayyarpaṇaṃ ca manasaṃ sarvakāmavivarjanam || madarthe'rthaparityāgo bhogasya ca sukhasya ca | iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ madarthaṃ yadvrataṃ tapam || evaṃ dharmairmanuṣyāṇāmuddhavātmanivedinām | mayi sañjāyate bhaktiṃ ko'nyo'rtho'syāvaśiṣyate || tathānyatra -- tasmādguruṃ prapadyeta jijñāsuṃ śreya uttamam | śābde pare ca niṣṇātaṃ brahmaṇyupaśamāśrayam || tatra bhāgavatāndharmānśikṣedgurvātmadaivatam | amāyayānuvṛttyā yaistuṣyedātmātmado harim || sarvato manaso'saṅgamādau saṅgaṃ ca sādhuṣu | dayāṃ maitrīṃ praśrayaṃ ca bhūteṣvaddhā yathocitam || śaucaṃ tapastitikṣāṃ ca maunaṃ svādhyāyamārjavam | brahmacaryamahiṃsāṃ ca samatvaṃ dvandvasaṃjñayom || sarvatrātmeśvarānvīkṣāṃ kaivalyamaniketatām | viviktacīravasanaṃ santoṣaṃ yena kenacita|| śraddhāṃ bhāgavate śāstre'nindāmanyatra cāpi hi | manovākkarmadaṇḍaṃ ca satyaṃ śamadamāvapi || śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ dhyānaṃ hareradbhutakarmaṇam | janmakarmaguṇānāṃ ca tadarthe'khilaceṣṭitam || iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ tapo japtaṃ vṛttaṃ yaccātmanaṃ priyam | dārānsutāngṛhānprāṇānyatparasmai nivedanam || evaṃ kṛṣṇātmanātheṣu manuṣyeṣu ca sauhṛdam | paricaryāṃ cobhayatra mahatsu nṛṣu sādhuṣu || parasparānukathanaṃ pāvanaṃ bhagavadyaśam | mitho ratirmithastuṣṭirnivṛttirmitha ātmanam || smarantaṃ smārayantaśca mitho'ghaughaharaṃ harim | bhaktyā sañjātayā bhaktyā bibhratyutpulakāṃ tanum || kvacidrudantyacyutacintayā kvacid dhasanti nandanti vadantyalaukikām | nṛtyanti gāyantyanuśīlayantyajaṃ bhavanti tūṣṇīṃ parametya nirvṛtām || iti bhāgavatāndharmānśikṣanbhaktyā tadutthayā | nārāyaṇaparo māyāmañjastarati dustarām || iti | tasmādevaṃvidhaiṃ śāstrīyairupāyairmanamśuddhiṃ sampādayedityartham || upāyāṃ prathamaskandhe nāradenopavarṇitām | saṅkṣepāttānahaṃ vakṣye bhūmibhedavibhāgatam ||33|| śāstrīyānevopāyānpratipannajanabuddhisaukaryāya bhūmikābhedena vaktuṃ pratijānīte -- upāyā iti | spaṣṭam ||33|| prathamaṃ mahatāṃ sevā taddayāpātratā tatam | śraddhātha teṣāṃ dharmeṣa tato hariguṇaśrutim ||34|| tato ratyaṅkurotpattiṃ svarūpādhigatistatam | premavṛddhiṃ parānande tasyātha sphuraṇaṃ tatam ||35|| bhagavaddharmaniṣṭhā'taṃ svasmiṃstadguṇaśālitā | premṇo'tha paramā kāṣṭhetyuditā bhaktibhūmikā ||36|| tānevāha prathamamityādi | yathā vyāsanāradasaṃvāde nāradam -- ahaṃ purātītabhave'bhavaṃ mune dāsyāstu kasyāścana vedavādinām | nirūpito bālaka eva yogināṃ śuśrūṣaṇe prāvṛṣi nirvivikṣatām || te mayyapetākhilacāpale'rbhake dānte'dhṛtakrīḍanake'nuvartini | cakruṃ kṛpāṃ yadyapi tulyadarśanām śuśrūṣamāṇe munayo'lpabhāṣiṇi || ucchiṣṭalepānanumodito dvijaim sakṛtsma bhuñje tadapāstakilbiṣam | evaṃ pravṛttasya viśuddhacetasas taddharma evātmaruciṃ prajāyate || tatrānvahaṃ kṛṣṇakathāṃ pragāyatām anugraheṇāśṛṇavaṃ manoharām | tāṃ śraddhayā me'nupadaṃ viśṛṇvatam priyaśravasyaṅga mamābhavadrucim || tasmiṃstadā labdharucermahāmate priyaśravasyaskhalitā matirmama || tasyaivaṃ me'nuraktasya praśritasya hatainasam | śraddadhānasya bālasya dāntasyānucarasya ca || jñānaṃ guhyatamaṃ yattatsākṣādbhagavatoditam | anvavocangamiṣyantaṃ kṛpayā dīnavatsalām || yenaivāhaṃ bhagavato vāsudevasya vedhasam | māyānubhāvamavidaṃ yena gacchanti tatpadam || etatsaṃsūcitaṃ brahmaṃstāpatrayacikitsitam | yadīśvare bhagavati karma brahmaṇi bhāvitam || āmayo yaśca bhūtānāṃ jāyate yena suvrata | tadeva hyāmayaṃ dravyaṃ na punāti cikitsitam || evaṃ nṛṇāṃ kriyāyogāṃ sarve saṃsṛtihetavam | ta evātmavināśāya kalpante kalpitāṃ pare || yadatra kriyate karma bhagavatparitoṣaṇam | jñānaṃ yattadadhīnaṃ hi bhaktiyogasamanvitam || kurvāṇā yatra karmāṇī bhagavacchikṣayāsakṛta| gṛṇanti guṇanāmāni kṛṣṇasyānusmaranti ca || oṃ namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya dhīmahi | pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namaṃ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca || iti mūrtyabhidhānena mantramūrtimamūrtikam | yajate yajñapuruṣaṃ sa samyagdarśanaṃ pumāna|| imaṃ svanigamaṃ brahmannavetya madanuṣṭhitam | adānme jñānamaiśvaryaṃ svasminbhāvaṃ ca keśavam || mahatsevā dvividhā -- bhagavadbhaktasevā sākṣādbhagavatsevā ca | tatrādyā, yathā -- mahatsevāṃ dvāramāhurvimuktes tamodvāraṃ yoṣitāṃ saṅgisaṅgam | mahāntaste samacittāṃ praśāntā vimanyavaṃ suhṛdaṃ sādhavo ye || ye vā mayīśe kṛtasauhṛdārthā janeṣu dehambharavārtikeṣu | gṛheṣu jāyātmajarātimatsu na prītiyuktā yāvadarthāśca loke || yathā -- prasaṅgamajaraṃ pāśamātmanaṃ kavayo vidum | sa eva sādhuṣu kṛto mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam || titikṣavaṃ kāruṇikāṃ suhṛdaṃ sarvadehinām | ajātaśatravaṃ śāntāṃ sādhavaṃ sādhubhūṣaṇām || mayyananyena bhāvena bhaktiṃ kurvanti ye dṛḍhām | matkṛte tyaktakarmāṇastyaktasvajanabāndhavām || madāśrayāṃ kathā mṛṣṭāṃ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca | tapanti vividhāstāpā naitānmadgatacetasam || ta ete sādhavaṃ sādhvi sarvasaṅgavivarjitām | saṅgasteṣvatha te prārthyaṃ saṅgadoṣaharā hi te || yathā -- yatpādasaṃśrayāṃ sūta munayaṃ praśamāyanām | sadyaṃ punantyupaspṛṣṭāṃ svardhunyāpo'nusevayā || tulayāma lavenāpi na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam | bhagavatsaṅgisaṅgasya martyānāṃ kimutāśiṣam || yathā -- durlabho mānuṣo deho dehināṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguram | tatrāpi durlabhaṃ manye vaikuṇṭhapriyadarśanam || ata ātyantiko kṣemaṃ pṛcchāmo bhavato'naghām | saṃsāre'sminkṣaṇārdho'pi satsaṅgaṃ śevadhirnṛṇām || yathā -- no rodhayati māṃ yogo na sāṅkhyaṃ dharma eva ca | na svādhyāyastapastyāgo neṣṭāpūrtaṃ na dakṣiṇā || vratāni yajñaśchandāṃsi tīrthāni niyamā yamām | yathāvarundhe satsaṅgaṃ sarvasaṅgāpaho hi mām || satsaṅgena hi daiteyā yātudhānā mṛgāṃ khagām | gandharvāpsaraso nāgāṃ siddhāścāraṇaguhyakām || vidyādharā manuṣyeṣu vaiśyāṃ śūdrāṃ striyo'ntyajām | rajastamamprakṛtaya tasmiṃstasminyuge yuge || bahavo matpadaṃ prāptāstvāṣṭrakāyādhavādayam | sākṣādbhagavatsevā, yathā -- vṛṣaparvā balirbāṇo mayaścātha vibhīṣaṇam || sugrīvo hanumānṛkṣo gajo gṛdhro vaṇikpatham | vyādhaṃ kubjā vraje gopyo yajñapatnyastathāpare || te nādhītaśrutigaṇā nopāsitamahattamām | avratātaptatapaso matsaṅgānmāmupāgatām || kevalena hi bhāvena gopyo gāvo nagā mṛgām | ye'nye mūṭhadhiyo nāgāṃ siddhā māmīyurañjasā || yaṃ na yogena sāṅkhyena dānavratatapo'dhvaraim | vyākhyāsvādhyāyasannyāsaiṃ prāpnuyādyatnavānapi || matkāmā ramaṇaṃ jāramasvarūpavido'balām | brahma māṃ paramaṃ prāpuṃ saṅgācchatasahasraśam || tasmāttvamuddhavotsṛjya codanāṃ praticodanām | pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca śrotavyaṃ śrutameva ca || māmekameva śaraṇamātmānaṃ sarvadehinām | yāhi sarvātmabhāvena mayā syā hyakutobhayam || tadayamatra niṣkarṣam -- bhagavatsaṅgaṃ vā bhagavatsaṅgisaṅgaṃ vā yathāyogyamantareṇa na bhagvati bhaktirudeti | etāvāṃstu viśeṣam -- bhagavatsaṅgināṃ kṛtārthatvānnānyasaṅgāpekṣeti vyākhyātā dvividhā mahatsevā | taddayāpātratā tatam | teṣāṃ mahatāṃ dayā svaviṣayā svakīyaiṃ suśīlatādiguṇairbhavati | te ca guṇā bhagavatoktām -- kṛpālurakṛtadrohastitikṣuṃ sarvadehinām | satyasāro'navadyātmā samaṃ sarvopakārakam || kāmairahatadhīrdānto mṛduṃ śucirakiñcanam | anīho mitabhukśāntaṃ sthiro maccharaṇo munim || apramatto gabhīrātmā dhṛtimāñ jitaṣaḍguṇam | amānī mānadaṃ kalyo maitraṃ kāruṇikaṃ kavim || tathā -- yamānabhīkṣṇaṃ seveta niyamānmatparaṃ kvacita| madabhijñaṃ guruṃ śāntamupāsīta madātmakam || amānyamatsaro dakṣo nirmamo dṛṭhasauhṛdam | asatvaro'rthajijñāsuranasūyuramoghavāka|| jāyāpatyagṛhakṣetra svajanadraviṇādiṣu | udāsīnaṃ samaṃ paśyansarveṣvarthamivātmanam || ityādi | udāharaṇaṃ prahlādam | yathā -- tasya daityapateṃ putrāścatvāraṃ paramādbhutām | prahrādo'bhūnmahāṃsteṣāṃ guṇairmahadupāsakam || brahmaṇyaṃ śīlasampannaṃ satyasandho jitendriyam | ātmavatsarvabhūtānāmekapriyasuhṛttamam || dāsavatsannatāryāṅghriṃ pitṛvaddīnavatsalam | bhrātṛvatsadṛśe snigdho guruṣvīśvarabhāvanam | vidyārtharūpajanmāḍhyo mānastambhavivarjitam || nodvignacitto vyasaneṣu nimspṛham śruteṣu dṛṣṭeṣu guṇeṣvavastudṛka| dāntendriyaprāṇaśarīradhīṃ sadā praśāntakāmo rahitāsuro'suram || etādṛśaśiṣyaguṇābhāve tu jāto'pi mahattamasaṅgo nirarthaka iti taddayāpātratā bhavati dvitīyā bhūmikā | sāpi dvividhā -- svaprayatnānapekṣā tatsāpekṣā ca | tatrādyā, yathā -- tarhyeva sarasastasmānniṣkrāmantaṃ sahānugam | upagīyamānamamara pravaraṃ vibudhānugaim || uvāca yūyaṃ vediṣadaṃ putrā viditaṃ vaścikīrṣitam | anugrahāya bhadraṃ va evaṃ me darśanaṃ kṛtam || yaṃ paraṃ raṃhasaṃ sākṣāttriguṇājjīvasaṃjñitāta| bhagavantaṃ vāsudevaṃ prapannaṃ sa priyo hi me || svadharmaniṣṭhaṃ śatajanmabhiṃ pumān viriñcatāmeti tataṃ paraṃ hi mām | avyākṛtaṃ bhāgavato'tha vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yathāhaṃ vibudhāṃ kalātyaye || atha bhāgavatā yūyaṃ priyāṃ stha bhagavānyathā | na madbhāgavatānāṃ ca preyānanyo'sti karhicita|| idaṃ viviktaṃ japtavyaṃ pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ param | nimśreyasakaraṃ cāpi śrūyatāṃ tadvadāmi vam || ityanukrośahṛdayo bhagavānāha tā' chivam | baddhāñjalīnrājaputrānnārāyaṇaparo vacam || ityādau rudrapracetasasaṃvāde | yathā vāte mayyapetākhilacāpale'rbhake ityatra | svaprayatnāpekṣā, yathā dhruvanāradasaṃvāde dhruva uvāca -- so'yaṃ śamo bhagavatā sukhadumkhahatātmanām | darśitaṃ kṛpayā puṃsāṃ durdarśo'smadvidhaistu yam || athāpi me'vinītasya kṣāttraṃ ghoramupeyuṣam | surucyā durvacobāṇairna bhinne śrayate hṛdi || padaṃ tribhuvanotkṛṣṭaṃ jigīṣoṃ sādhu vartma me | brūhyasmatpitṛbhirbrahmannanyairapyanadhiṣṭhitam || nūnaṃ bhavānbhagavato yo'ṅgajaṃ parameṣṭhinam | vitudannaṭate vīṇāṃ hitāya jagato'rkavata|| maitreya uvāca -- ityudāhṛtamākarṇya bhagavānnāradastadā | prītaṃ pratyāha taṃ bālaṃ sadvākyamanukampayā || nārada uvāca -- jananyābhihitaṃ panthāṃ sa vai nimśreyasasya te | bhagavānvāsudevastaṃ bhaja taṃ pravaṇātmanā || dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyaṃ ya icchecchreya ātmanam | ekaṃ hyeva harestatra kāraṇaṃ pādasevanam || tattāta gaccha bhadraṃ te yamunāyāstaṭaṃ śuci | puṇyaṃ madhuvanaṃ yatra sānnidhyaṃ nityadā harem || śraddhā'tha teṣāṃ dharmeṣu | pūrvoktaguṇasampannasya mahattamānsevamānasyaitādṛśadharmānuṣṭhānādahamapi kṛtārtho bhaveyamiti ruciviśeṣarūpā śraddhā taddharmeṣu bhavati | taduktam -- yadanudhyāsinā yuktāṃ karmagranthinibandhanam | chindanti kovidāstasya ko na kuryātkathāratiṃ || śuśrūṣoṃ śraddadhānasya vāsudevakathārucim | syānmahatsevayā viprāṃ puṇyatīrthaniṣevaṇāta|| jñānaṃ yadāpratinivṛttaguṇormicakram ātmaprasāda uta yatra guṇeṣvasaṅgam | kaivalyasammatapathastvatha bhaktiyogam ko nirvṛto harikathāsu ratiṃ na kuryāta|| ityādi | harikathāpadamanyeṣāmapi bhāgavatadharmāṇāmupalakṣaṇam | yathāha brahmā -- tadastu me nātha sa bhūribhāgo bhave'tra vānyatra tu vā tiraścām | yenāhameko'pi bhavajjanānāṃ bhūtvā niṣeve tava pādapallavam || ityatra pādasevanam | evamanyadapyūhyam | iyaṃ ca śraddhā sādhanaparipākeṇa vardhamānaihikāmuṣmikasarvaviṣayārucimupajanayantī bubhukṣeva bhakṣyamātraikaśaraṇaṃ bhagavaddharmācaraṇaikajīvanaṃ puruṣamāpādayati | yathā parīkṣitam -- naiṣātidumsahā kṣunmāṃ tyaktodamapi bādhate | pibantaṃ tvanmukhāmbhoja cyutaṃ harikathāmṛtam || ityādibhyam | yathā vā śaunikādīnām -- āyurharati vai puṃsāmudyannastaṃ ca yannasau | tasyarte yatkṣaṇo nīta uttamaślokavārtayā || bile batorukramavikramānye na śṛṇvataṃ karṇapuṭe narasya | jihvāsatī dārdurikeva sūta na copagāyatyurugāyagāthām || bhāraṃ paraṃ paṭṭakirīṭajuṣṭam apyuttamāṅgaṃ na namenmukundam | śāvau karau no kurute saparyāṃ harerlasatkāñcanakaṅkaṇau vā || barhāyite te nayane narāṇāṃ liṅgāni viṣṇorna nirīkṣato ye | pādau nṛṇāṃ tau drumajanmabhājau kṣetrāṇi nānuvrajato hareryau || jīvañ chavo bhāgavatāṅghrireṇuṃ na jātu martyo'bhilabheta yastu | śrīviṣṇupadyā manujastulasyām śvasañ chavo yastu na veda gandham || tadaśmasāraṃ hṛdayaṃ batedaṃ yadgṛhyamāṇairharināmadheyaim | na vikriyetātha yadā vikāro netre jalaṃ gātraruheṣu harṣam || ityādau | śraddhāvihīnāstu kecidviṣayabhogaparām | kecitpāṇḍityādigarveṇa bhagavadbhkatanindāparāṃ santo niraye'pi nindanīyā eva bhavanti | tatra prathame, yathā -- yanna vrajantyaghabhido racanānuvādāc chṛṇvanti ye'nyaviṣayāṃ kukathā matighnīm | yāstu śrutā hatabhagairnṛbhirāttasārās tāṃstānkṣipantyaśaraṇeṣu tamamsu hanta || taravaṃ kiṃ na jīvanti bhastrāṃ kiṃ na śvasantyuta | na khādanti na mehanti kiṃ grāme paśavo'pare || śvaviḍvarāhoṣṭrakharaiṃ saṃstutaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum | na yatkarṇapathopeto jātu nāma gadāgrajam || ityādi | bhagavadbhaktanindāparā, yathā -- mukhabāhūrupādebhyaṃ puruṣasyāśramaiṃ saha | catvāro jajñire varṇā guṇairviprādayaṃ pṛthaka|| ya eṣāṃ puruṣaṃ sākṣādātmaprabhavamīśvaram | na bhajantyavajānanti sthānādbhraṣṭāṃ patantyadham || dūre harikathāṃ keciddūre cācyutakīrtanām | striyaṃ śūdrādayaścaiva te'nukampyā bhavādṛśām || rajasā ghorasaṅkalpāṃ kāmukā ahimanyavam | dāmbhikā māninaṃ pāpā vihasantyacyutapriyāna|| vadanti te'nyonyamupāsitastriyo gṛheṣu maithunyapareṣu cāśiṣam | yajantyasṛṣṭānnavidhānadakṣiṇaṃ vṛttyai paraṃ ghnanti paśūnatadvidam || śriyā vibhūtyābhijanena vidyayā tyāgena rūpeṇa balena karmaṇā | jātasmayenāndhadhiyaṃ saheśvarān sato'vamanyanti haripriyānkhalām || sarveṣu śaśvattanubhṛtsvavasthitaṃ yathā khamātmānamabhīṣṭamīśvaram | vedopagītaṃ ca na śṛṇvate'budhā manorathānāṃ pravadanti vārtayā || hitvātmamāyāracitā gṛhāpatyasuhṛtstriyam | tamo viśantyanicchanto vāsudevaparāṅmukhām || na bhajati kumanīṣiṇāṃ sa ijyāṃ hariradhanātmadhanapriyo rasajñam | śrutadhanakulakarmaṇāṃ madairye vidadhati pāpamakiñcaneṣu satsu || evamanyadapyūhanīyam | tasmādbhagavaddharmaśraddhā bhavati tṛtīyā bhūmikā | tato hariguṇaśrutim, yathā -- itthaṃ parasya nijavartmarirakṣayātta līlātanostadanurūpaviḍambanāni | karmāṇi karmakaṣaṇāni yadūttamasya śrūyādamuṣya padayoranuvṛttimicchana|| martyastayānusavamedhitayā mukunda śrīmatkathāśravaṇakīrtanacintayaiti | taddhāma dustarakṛtāntajavāpavargaṃ grāmādvanaṃ kṣitibhujo'pi yayuryadarthām || saṃsārasindhumatidustaramuttitīrṣor nānyaṃ plavo bhagavato puruṣottamasya | līlākathārasaniṣevanamantareṇa puṃso bhavedvividhadumkhadavārditasya || nivṛttatarṣairupagīyamānād bhavauṣadhācchrotramano'bhirāmāta| ka uttamaślokaguṇānuvādāt pumānvirajyeta vinā paśughnāta|| ko nu rājannindriyavānmukundacaraṇāmbujam | na bhajetsarvatomṛtyurupāsyanamarottamaim || tacca bhajanaṃ vivṛtam -- śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇoṃ smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam | arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam || iti puṃsārpitā viṣṇau bhaktiścennavalakṣaṇā | kriyeta bhagavatyaddhā tanmanye'dhītamuttamam || tadeva saṅkṣiptam -- tasmādbhārata sarvātmā bhagavānīśvaro harim | śrotavyaṃ kīrtitavyaśca smartavyaścecchatābhayam || krameṇodāharaṇam -- patitaṃ skhalitaścārtaṃ kṣuttvā vā vivaśo gṛṇana| haraye nama ityuccairmucyate sarvapātakāta|| saṅkīrtyamāno bhagavānanantam śrutānubhāvo vyasanaṃ hi puṃsām | praviśya cittaṃ vidhunotyaśeṣaṃ yathā tamo'rko'bhramivātivātam || mṛṣā girastā hyasatīrasatkathā na kathyate yadbhagavānadhokṣajam | tadeva satyaṃ tadu haiva maṅgalaṃ tadeva puṇyaṃ bhagavadguṇodayam || tadeva ramyaṃ ruciraṃ navaṃ navaṃ tadeva śaśvanmanaso mahotsavam | tadeva śokārṇavaśoṣaṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ yaduttamamślokayaśo'nugīyate || na tadvacaścitrapadaṃ hareryaśo jagatpavitraṃ pragṛṇīta karhicita| taddhvāṅkṣatīrthaṃ na tu haṃsasevitaṃ yatrācyutastatra hi sādhavo'malām || tadvāgvisargo janatāghasamplavo yasminpratiślokamabaddhavatyapi | nāmānyanantasya yaśo'ṅkitāni yat śṛṇvanti gāyanti gṛṇanti sādhavam || naiṣkarmyamapyacyutabhāvavarjitaṃ na śobhate jñānamalaṃ nirañjanam | kutaṃ punaṃ śaśvadabhadramīśvare na hyarpitaṃ karma yadapyanuttamam || yaśamśriyāmeva pariśramaṃ paro varṇāśramācāratapamśrutādiṣu | avismṛtiṃ śrīdharapādapadmayor guṇānuvādaśravaṇādarādibhim || avismṛtiṃ kṛṣṇapadāravindayom kṣiṇotyabhadrāṇi ca śaṃ tanoti | sattvasya śuddhiṃ paramātmabhaktiṃ jñānaṃ ca vijñānavirāgayuktam || smarataṃ pādakamalamātmānamapi yacchati | kiṃ nvarthakāmānbhajato nātyabhīṣṭānjagadgurum || dṛṣṭaṃ tavāṅghriyugalaṃ janatāpavargaṃ brahmādibhirhṛdi vicintyamagādhabodhaim | saṃsārakūpapatitottaraṇāvalambaṃ dhyāyaṃścarāmyanugṛhāṇa yathā smṛtiṃ syāta|| taṃ naṃ samādiśopāyaṃ yena te caraṇābjayom | smṛtiryathā na viramedapi saṃsaratāmiha || tasmādrajorāgaviṣādamanyu mānaspṛhābhayadainyādhimūlam | hitvā gṛhaṃ saṃsṛticakravālaṃ nṛsiṃhapādaṃ bhajatākutobhayamiti || aho amīṣāṃ kimakāri śobhanaṃ prasanna eṣāṃ sviduta svayaṃ harim | yairjanma labdhaṃ nṛṣu bhāratājire mukundasevaupayikaṃ spṛhā hi nam || yāṃ samparyacaranpremṇā pādasaṃvāhanādibhim | jagadguruṃ bhartṛbuddhyā tāsāṃ kiṃ varṇyate tapam || vaidikastāntriko miśra iti me trividho makhaṃ | trayāṇāmīpsitenaiva vidhinā māṃ samarcayeta|| evaṃ kriyāyogapathaiṃ pumānvaidikatāntrikaiṃ | arcannubhayataṃ siddhiṃ matto vindatyabhīpsitāṃ || yatpādayoraśaṭhadhīṃ salilaṃ pradāya dūrvāṅkurairapi vidhāya satīṃ saparyām | apyuttamāṃ gatimasau bhajate trilokīṃ dāśvānaviklavamanāṃ kathamārtiṃ ṛccheta|| yadyuttamaśloka bhavānmameritaṃ vaco vyalīkaṃ suravarya manyate | karomyṛtaṃ tanna bhavetpralambhanaṃ padaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kuru śīrṣṇi me nijam || tatte'nukampāṃ susamīkṣamāṇo bhuñjāna evātmakṛtaṃ vipākaṃ | hṛdvāgvapurbhirvidadhannamaste jīveta yo muktipade sa dāyabhāk || mamādyāmaṅgalaṃ naṣṭaṃ phalavāṃścaiva me bhavam | yannamasye bhagavato yogidhyeyāṅghripaṅkajam || patitaṃ skhalitaścārtaṃ kṣuttvā vā vivaśo gṛṇana| haraye nama ityuccairmucyate sarvapātakāta|| natāṃ sma te nātha padāravindaṃ buddhīndriyaprāṇamanovacobhim | yaccintyate'ntarhṛdi bhāvayuktair mumukṣubhiṃ karmamayorupāśāta|| śrīmadbhagavadgītāsu ca -- manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru | māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me || yannāmaśrutimātreṇa pumānbhavati nirmalam | tasya tīrthapadaṃ kiṃ vā dāsānāmavaśiṣyate || kiṃ citramacyuta tavaitadaśeṣabandho dāseṣvananyaśaraṇeṣu yadātmasāttvam | yo'rocayatsaha mṛgaiṃ svayamīśvarāṇāṃ śrīmatkirīṭataṭapīḍitapādapīṭham || kāyena vācā manasendriyairvā buddhyātmanā vānusṛtasvabhāvāta| karoti yadyatsakalaṃ parasmai nārāyaṇāyeti samarpayettata|| aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ nandagopavrajaukasām | yanmitraṃ paramānandaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahma sanātanaṃ || itthaṃ satāṃ brahmasukhānubhūtyā dāsyaṃ gatānāṃ paradaivatena | māyāśritānāṃ naradārakeṇa sākaṃ vijahruṃ kṛtapuṇyapuñjām || martyo yadā tyaktasamastakarmā niveditātmā vicikīrṣito me | tadāmṛtatvaṃ pratipadyamāno mayātmabhūyāya ca kalpate vai || dharmārthakāma iti yo'bhihitastrivarga īkṣā trayī nayadamau vividhā ca vārtā | manye tadetadakhilaṃ nigamasya satyaṃ svātmārpaṇaṃ svasuhṛdaṃ paramasya puṃsam || devarṣibhūtāptanṛṇāṃ pitèṇāṃ na kiṅkaro nāyaṃ ṛṇī ca rājana| sarvātmanā yaṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ gato mukundaṃ parihṛtya kartam || tasmādevaṃrūpeṇa yathāśakti bhāgavatadharmānuṣṭhāne bhavati caturthī bhūmikā | etaccatuṣṭayaṃ sādhanameva | tato ratyaṅkurotpattim | ratirnāma bhaktirasasthāyibhāvo drutacittapraviṣṭabhagavadākāratārūpaṃ saṃskāraviśeṣa iti vakṣyate | sa evāṅkuro bhāgavatadharmānuṣṭhānātmakabījasya | taduktam -- satāṃ prasaṅgānmama vīryasaṃvido bhavanti hṛtkarṇarasāyanāṃ kathām | tajjoṣaṇādāśvapavargavartmani śraddhā ratirbhaktiranukramiṣyati || śraddhā bhaktirasānubhave, tato ratiṃ sthāyibhāvam, tataṃ sa eva bhaktirasatāṃ prāpto'nukrameṇa bhaviṣyatītyartham | evaṃ manaṃ karmavaśaṃ prayuṅkte avidyayātmanyupadhīyamāne | prītirna yāvanmayi vāsudeve na mucyate dehayogena tāvata|| bhavāpavargo bhramato yadā bhavej janasya tarhyacuta satsamāgamam | satsaṅgamo yarhi tadaiva sadgatau parāvareśe tvayi jāyate matim || tvayi me'nanyaviṣayā matirmadhupate'sakṛta| ratimudvahatādaddhā gaṅgevaughamudanvati || karmabhirbhrāmyamāṇānāṃ yatra kvāpīśvarecchayā | maṅgalācaritairdānai ratirnaṃ kṛṣṇa īśvare || iyaṃ ca pañcamī bhūmikā bhakteṃ svarūpam | etasyā eva paripākaviśeṣādanyāṃ ṣaḍbhūmikāṃ phalabhūtām | svarūpādhigatistatam | pratyagātmasvarūpasya sthūlasūkṣmadehadvayātiriktatvena sākṣātkāraṃ ṣaṣṭhī bhūmikā | anyathā dehendriyādivikṣepeṇa jātāyā api rateranirvāhāta| taduktam -- jñānaṃ nimśreyasārthāya puruṣasyātmadarśanam | yadāhurvarṇaye tatte hṛdayagranthibhedanam || anādirātmā puruṣo nirguṇaṃ prakṛteṃ param | pratyagdhāmā svayaṃjyotirviśvaṃ yena samanvitam || sa eṣa prakṛtiṃ sūkṣmāṃ daivīṃ guṇamayīṃ vibhum | yadṛcchayaivopagatāmabhyapadyata līlayā || guṇairvicitrāṃ sṛjatīṃ sarūpāṃ prakṛtiṃ prajām | vilokya mumuhe sadyaṃ sa iha jñānagūhayā || evaṃ parābhidhyānena kartṛtvaṃ prakṛteṃ pumāna| karmasu kriyamāṇeṣu guṇairātmani manyate || tadasya saṃsṛtirbandhaṃ pāratantryaṃ ca tatkṛtam | bhavatyakarturīśasya sākṣiṇo nirvṛtātmanam || tathā -- ātmā nityo'vyayaṃ śuddha ekaṃ kṣetrajña āśrayam | avikriyaṃ svadṛgheturvyāpako'saṅgyanāvṛtam || etairdvādaśabhirvidvānātmano lakṣaṇaiṃ paraim | ahaṃ mametyasadbhāvaṃ dehādau mohajaṃ tyajeta|| evaṃ śuddhe tvampadalakṣye'vagate tatpadalakṣyeṇa sahābhedajñānaṃ bhavati | etadapyuktam -- kṛṣṇamenamavehi tvamātmānamakhilātmanāṃ | jagaddhitāya so'pyatra dehīvābhāti māyayā || ityādi | etādṛśajñānasya ca bhaktyuttarakālatvaṃ darśitam -- vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktiyogaṃ prayojitam | janayatyāśu vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ ca yadahaitukam || śreyamsrutiṃ bhaktimudasya te vibho kliśyanti ye kevalabodhalabdhaye | teṣāmasau kleśala eva śiṣyate nānyadyathā sthūlatuṣāvaghātināṃ || ityādi | etādṛśatattvajñāne sati vairāgyadārḍhyādbhagavati premṇo vṛddhirbhavatīti saptamī bhūmikā, yathā -- nyastakrīḍanako bālo jaḍavattanmanastayā | kṛṣṇagrahagṛhītātmā na veda jagadīdṛśam || āsīnaṃ paryaṭannaśnanśayānaṃ prapibanbruvana| nānusandhatta etāni govindaparirambhitam || kvacidrudati vaikuṇṭha cintāśabalacetanam | kvaciddhasati taccintā hlāda udgāyati kvacita|| nadati kvacidutkaṇṭho vilajjo nṛtyati kvacita| kvacittadbhāvanāyuktastanmayo'nucakāra ha || kvacidutpulakastūṣṇīmāste saṃsparśanirvṛtam | aspandapraṇayānanda salilāmīlitekṣaṇam || sa uttamaślokapadāravindayor niṣevayākiñcanasaṅgalabdhayā | tanvanparāṃ nirvṛtimātmano muhur dumsaṅgadīnasya manaṃ śamaṃ vyadhāta|| sa prahlādam, tathā -- evaṃ nirjitaṣaḍvargaiṃ kriyate bhaktirīśvare | vāsudeve bhagavati yayā saṃlabhyate ratim || niśamya karmāṇi guṇānatulyān vīryāṇi līlātanubhiṃ kṛtāni | yadātiharṣotpulakāśrugadgadaṃ protkaṇṭha udgāyati rauti nṛtyati || yadā grahagrasta iva kvaciddhasaty ākrandate dhyāyati vandate janam | muhuṃ śvasanvakti hare jagatpate nārāyaṇetyātmamatirgatatrapam || tadā pumānmuktasamastabandhanas tadbhāvabhāvānukṛtāśayākṛtim | nirdagdhabījānuśayo mahīyasā bhaktiprayogeṇa sametyadhokṣajam || adhokṣajālambhamihāśubhātmanam śarīriṇaṃ saṃsṛticakraśātanam | tadbrahmanirvāṇasukhaṃ vidurbudhās tato bhajadhvaṃ hṛdaye hṛdīśvaram || evamanyadapyūhanīyam | etādṛśasaptamīparyanta eva sādhanābhyāsam | ataṃ parantu bhūmikācatuṣṭayamayatnasādhyam | tasyātha sphuraṇam | tasya premāspadībhūtasya bhagavataṃ sākṣātkārapremātiśayahetuko'ṣṭamī bhūmikā | taduktam -- naikātmatāṃ me spṛhayanti kecin matpādasevābhiratā madīhām | ye'nyonyato bhāgavatāṃ prasajya kāryajñāpyādivaidharmyaṃ yattu kaiścinnirūpitam | tadapyetena mārgeṇa yojyaṃ śāstrāvirodhatam ||23|| paramānanda ātmaiva rasa ityāhurāgamām | śabdatastadabhivyaktiprakāro'yaṃ pradarśitam ||24|| arthavādādhikaraṇe vanaśailādivarṇanam | śrotèṇāṃ sukhamātrārthamiti bhaṭṭairudāhṛtam ||25|| kāryānvitatvavāde'pi na virodho'sti kaścana | yasmātkṛtīpsitatvena kāryaṃ sukhamapīṣyate ||26|| alaukikaniyoge tu na kiṃcinmānamīkṣyate | loke vācāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tatparatvaṃ na yujyate ||27|| prayojanavadajñātajñāpakatvaṃ ca mānatā | śabdasya kāryaparatā tvācāryaireva khaṇḍitā ||28|| devatādhikṛtinyāyātpadairanyaparairapi | prayojanavadajñātābādhitārthamatirbhaveta||29|| tasmādanyaparatve vā svātantrye vā padāni nam | vyañjayanti parānandaṃ sahakāryānurūpyatam ||30|| iti śrīparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryavaryaviśvaviśrutasarvatantrasvatantratāka śrīmadhusūdanasarasvatīviracite śrībhagavadbhaktirasāyane bhaktiviśeṣanirūpaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyollāsam ||3||
